question_text: Grammar Rules — tag question
guide_solution: Tag question /( যুক্ত প্রশ্ন বা জুড়ে দেওয়া) সংজ্ঞা:-বক্তা তারবক্তব্য সম্পকের্ শ্রোতার মতামত যাচাইয়ের জন্য বক্তব্যের শেষে যে ছোট প্রশ্ন জুড়ে দেয় তাকেtag Question বলে। অথবা কোনstatement এর শেষে বক্তার বক্তব্যের সমথর্ন পেতে আমরা অনেক সময় বলে থাকি "তাই কি"/তাই নয় কি/সেকি/সেকি নয়" ইত্যাদি expression কেইtag question বলে। যথা:- • Tahsin is a regular student, isn’t she? (তাহসিন একজন নিয়মিত ছাত্রী তাই নয় কি?) ব্যাখ্যা:-এখানেAuxiliary verb ‘is’ এর কারণে‘is’ হয়েছে +Statement টিAffirmative statement থাকায়tag টি Negative হয়েছে“isn’t” আর“Tahsin” মেয়ে দেখে“She” হয়েছে + প্রশ্নবোধক চিহ্ন (?) বসেছে। Tag নিয়ে জরম্নরি নিদের্শনা 1. প্রথমেSentence/statement টিAffirmative/nagetive এ আছে কি না সেটা দেখতে হবে। র্2. Auxiliary verb কে খুজে বের করতে হবে অনেক ÿেত্রেAuxiliary verb দেওয়া না থাকলেmain verb থেকেAuxiliary verb বের করেdo verb “do/does/did” কে বসাতে হবে Tense, Sub ওverb অনুসারে। 3. Sub খুজতে হবে। Tag নিয়ে টেকনিক 1. Sentence বাStatement টিAffirmative হলেtag টিnegative হবে। 2. Sentence বাStatement টিNegative হলেtag টিAffirmative হবে। Affirmative statement = Negative Tag. Negative Statement = Affirmative tag. Tag সম্পেকর্ যা জানা দরকার • Tag question এর অপর নামTag/mini question. • প্রথম অংশকেsentence/statement বলে এবং দ্বিতীয় অংশকেtag question/mini বলে। • “Auxiliary verb” not/n’t না বোধক এবংSubject word এরpronoun form এগুূেলা সমন্ধে জ্ঞান রাখতে হবে। এবং মূলSentence এর কোন পরিবতর্ন হয় না। • মূল বাক্যেAuxiliary verb থাকলে ঐAuxiliary verb টিtag অংশে চলে যাবে। কিন্তু মূল বাক্যেAuxiliary verb না থাকলে মূলverb এর রম্নপ অনুযায়ীtag অংশেDo verb ( do/did/does) বসবে। • সব শেষে প্রশ্ন বোধক চিহ্ন (?) বসবে। প্রশ্ন বোধক চিহ্ন (?) না দিলে উত্তর ভুল হবে। Structure of tag question: Sentence/Statement tag question Affirmative. tag Negative. tag Statement/হ্যা বোধক Statement/না বোধক Tag → হ্যা বোধক Tag → না বোধক Exam: • Himu was writing, wasn’t she? (Negative tag) • Raju can’t swim, can he? (Affirmative tag) • I could solve the sum, couldn’t I? (Negative tag) • He has not completed the task, has he. (Affirmative tag) ব্যাখ্যা:১ম বাক্যটিAffi Statement এ আছে বিধায়tag টিnegative হয়েছে। আর দ্বিতীয় বাক্যটিNegative Statement এ আছে বিধায়tag টিAffirmative হয়েছে। Note: Tag Question এরSubject কখনোইNoun হয় না। শুধুpronoun এ ব্যবহৃত হয়।Contraction form এ লিখতে হবে। ** Tag Question এরauxiliary verb গুলোকে সব সময়contraction form এ লিখতে হয়। 1. Am not = ain’t/aren’t (কিন্তু amn’t হবে না) 2. is not =Isn’t 3. Are not =Aren’t 4. was not =Wasn’t 5. were not =Weren’t 6. have not =Have’t 7. has not =Hasn’t 8. had not =Hadn’t 9. shall not =Shan’t (Shalln’t হবে না) 10. will not =Won’t (willn’t হবে না) 11. should not =Shouldn’t 12. would not =Wouldn’t 13. Cannot =Can’t 14. Could not =Couldn’t 15. Might not =Mightn’t 16. Must not =Mustn’t 17. Do not =Don’t 18. Did not =Didn’t 19. Does not =Doesn’t 20. Need not =Needn’t 21. Used not =Usedn’t 22. Ought not to =Oughtn’t to ** অনেক সময়statement এ কোনAuxiliary verb দেওয়া থাকে না। এÿেত্রেstatement এরmain verb থেকেAuxiliary verb বের করে নিতে হয়। v1 থাকলে ⇨ do লিখতে হবে। v2 থাকলে⇨ did v (s/es/ies) থাকলে⇨ does লিখতে হয়। যথা:- • He helps me, doesn’t he? ব্যাখ্যা:- ‘help’ verb এর সাথে‘s’ যোগ হওয়ায়doesn’t হয়েছে (মূলত এখানেauxiliary verb নেই)। • We take tea, don’t we? ব্যাখ্যা:- ‘take’ এখানে‘veb’ অবস্থায় আছে বিধায়don’t বসেছে। • She helped me, didn’t she? ব্যাখ্যা:- ‘helped’ এখানেv2 তাইdid not বসেছে। Tag Question এর ÿেত্রেSubject এর পরিবতর্ন Subject of Statement Sub in tag Raju (Name of পুরম্নষ) He Tahsin (Name of মেয়ে) She All থাকলে It All + Noun থাকলে(plural) They --- যত রকমের .........body ………any body, They somebody, nobody etc --- যত রকমের .........one ……… anyone, They someone, no one etc --- যত রকমেরThing ……… any thing, some He (বড় হাতের) thing etc Allah.God We … of us থাকলেone of us most of us etc We …… of yo You ….. of them …… most of them, some of They them, All of them etc. একের অধি ব্যক্তি/বস্তু They Abstract noun .Material noun এর ÿেত্রে It বসবে 1+2+3 (I + you + he) present We 2+3 (you+he) 2nd person You 3+3 (he + he) 3rd person They This/That This/That or it This/That + Noun It These/Those These/those/they Each/every + Noun They Rule-1:- কোনStatement/sentence এরNever, no, none, no one, no body, nothing, nowhere, neither, hardly, rarely, basely, Scarcely, Seldom, few, little ইত্যাদি থাকলেtag Question টিAffirmative হয়। কারণ এদের মধ্যেইNegative আছে। Note:- কিন্তুa few, a little, The few, The little থাকলেStatement টিকেAffirmative ধরে নিতে হয়। যেমন:- • Tahsin hardly helps me, does she? ব্যাখ্যা;- Auxiliary verb নেই তাইtag এdoes হয়েছে এবংhardly থাকার পরেওTag টিAffirmative হয়েছে আর মেয়ে হওয়াই (She + ?) হয়েছে। • He has few friends, has he? ব্যাখ্যা:- “few” থাকার পরেওtag টিnegative হয়নি কারণfew এর মধ্যেইNegative আছে। • He has a few friends, hasn’t he? ব্যখ্যা:-“a few” থাকার কারণেtag টিnegative হয়েছে। Rule-2:- Imperative Sentence এ 1. let’s/let us → থাকলে shall we? লিখতে হয় 2. → অন্যান্য সকল ÿেত্রে will we? লেখতে হয়। যেমন:- 1. Please, help me, will you? 2. Don’t vix me, will you? 3. Let me go, will you? 4. Let’s discuss the matter, Shall we? ব্যাখ্যা:- প্রথম তিনটি উদাহরণেLet’s let us নেই তাইwill we? বসেছে। আর চতুথর্ নং এlet’s থাকায়Shall we? বসেছে। Note:- অনেক সময়will you? এরপরিবতের্won’t you?-ও লেখা যায়। Rule-3:- Primary auxiliary verb:- do, does, did, an, is, are, was, were, have, has, had যোগে গঠিত কিছুtag. যেমন:- • I am a student, aren’t I? ব্যাখ্যা:- Statement টিpositive + “am” A.v থাকায়aren’t হয়েছে। • You have done it, haven’t you? ব্যাখ্যা:- Statement টিpositive + “am” A.v থাকায়are n’t হয়েছে। • You have done it, haven’t you? ব্যাখ্যা:- “have” A.v থাকায়haven’t হয়েছে। • He is not a teacher, is he? ব্যাখ্যা:- Statement টিNegative তাইtag টিAffirmative হয়েছে। Rule-4:- Modal Auxiliary verb: May, dare, might, Can, could, shall, should, will, would, must, need etc যোগে কিছুtag. যেমন:- • We may fail at first, mayn’t we? ব্যাখ্যা:- May এর কারণেMayn’t হয়েছে। Rule-5:- It is/it was/it has দ্বারা সুগঠিতstatement এর ÿেত্রেtag question হিসেবেis it/isn’t/was it/wasn’t it/has it/hasn’t it বসে। যেমন:- • It is fairly a recent invention, isn’t it? ব্যাখ্যা:- “It is” এর কারণেisn’t it? হয়েছে। *কোন বাক্যের শুরম্নতে যদিThis, That, These, Those subject হিসেবে থাকে তাহলে নিচের নিয়ম অনুসরণ করতে হয়। → Sub হিসেবে থাকলে এদের পরিবতের্it/they বসে।Singular হলেit এরplural হলেthey? যেমন:- • This is my book, is’t it? • These are by books, aren’t they? *কোন বাক্যের শুরম্নতে যদিAll of us, Some of us, Every one of us, Most of us, None of us শব্দগুলোsubject হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়tag-এ এদের পরিবতের্we বসে। যেমন:- • All of us should help the poor, shouldn’t we? • All of us attended the meting, didn’t we? *কোনstatement এ যদিAll of them, Some of them, Every one of them, Most of them, None of them এইword গুলো থাকে তাহলেtag এthey বসে। যেমন:- • All of them should help the poor, shouldn’t they? • Most of them were abstract, weren’t they? Rule:19:- কোনোsentence এsubject হিসেবেnone of, many of, many of, some of, most of, any of থাকে তবেtag question এsubject হিসেবে ব্যক্তি বোঝালে“they” বিষয় বস্তু বোঝালে“it” বসে। যেমন:- • None of the problems can be solved, can it? • Most of the people knew it before, didn’t they? ব্যাখ্যা:- উপরে উলেস্নখিত শব্দসমূহের পরnoun টি সবর্দাইplural হয়। যেমন:none of the problems, some of the problems, most of the students etc. Rule:20:- Complex sentence কেtag করার সময় সবর্দাইmain clause এর দিকে লÿ রেখেtag করতে হয়। যেমন:- • If you say, I will go, won’t I? • What you say is not true, isn’t it? • I can help you as you desire, can’t I? ব্যাখ্যা:- প্রথম বাক্যে“I will go” main clause। দ্বিতীয় বাক্যে মূলত“It is not true” এইটাmain clause এবং তৃতীয় বাক্যে“I can lelp you” এইটাmain clause। [clause অধ্যায় থেকেclause সম্বন্ধে জেনে নাও] Rule-9:- Here, there, one, this, that, these, those, it etc. Subject দ্বারাsentence শুরম্ন হলেtag এ এ উক্ত শব্দ সমূহ subject হয়। যেমন:- • Here is a phone number, isn’t here? • There is a problem between you and him, isn’t herer? • One should follow one’s financial condition, shouldn’t one? Rule-10:- কোনো বাক্যেsubject হিসেবেeverybody, somebody, nobody, everyone, none, no one ect. থাকলে Pronoun হিসেবেtag এthey বসে। যেমন:- • Everybody wants to be happy, don’t they? • None can trust a liar, can they? ব্যাখ্যা:- উক্ত শব্দগুলো থাকলে যেহেতুpronoun হয়they, সেই জন্য“they” এইpronoun অনুযায়ীauxiliary verb বসাতে হবে। এই জন্য“doesn’t they” নয় বরং“do they” হয়েছে। Rule-12:- nothing/anything/something থাকলেtag এpronoun হিসেবেit হবে। যেমন:- • Nothing can be possible without great effort, can it? • Anything is accepted, isn’t it? Rule-14:- Used to যদিও একটিmodal verb কিন্তুtag question এused to তুলে দিয়েdid ব্যবহার করতে হয়। যেমন:- • They used to talk more than need, didn’t they? • He used to swim in the river daily, didn’t he? Rule-15:- Subject-verb বিহীনexclamatory sentence এরtag করতেisn’t it বসাতে হয়। তবে,exclamatory sentence টিতেsubject, verb উলেস্নখ থাকলে উক্তsubject-verb অনুযায়িtag হবে। যেমন:- • How odd, isn’t it? • How funny, Isn’t it? • What a fantastic idea it was, wasn’t it? Rule-16:- কোনোclause, phrase, infinitive phrase, verbal noun (v+ing) etc. যদি বাক্যেরsubject হয় তবেtag এ pronoun হিসেবেit বসে। যেমন:- • What you said yesterday is completely fake (মিথ্যা),isn’t it? • To speak with the foreigners helps you to know them, doesn’t it? • Swimming in the river is called the best exercise, isn’t it? Note:- 1. To + v1 + ext. হলে তাinfinitive phrase

guide_solution: English (Compulsory)– First Paper Part−A : Reading Test 1. (a) iv. designed (b) iii. media for communicating with others (c) i. recurrently (d) iii. social networking services (e) iv. Internet (f) ii. rise (g) ii. privacy 2. (a) A social networking service is an online platform where people can create profiles, connect with friends, and share content like photos and messages. It is like a digital community where users interact and stay connected with each other. (b) Social networks play a key role in making global community by connecting people across the globe. They allow individuals to interact, share information, and engage in conversations regardless of their geographical location. Features like instant messaging, group discussions, and video calls help people connect and collaborate with others around the world. This facilities the sharing of ideas, cultures, and perspectives, ultimately contributing to a more interconnected and making global community. (c) Social networks work by allowing users to create profiles, connect with others, and share content over the internet. Users can communicate through messaging, posting, commenting, and liking each others content. (d) The clause indicates the easy access of the people to the social networking services. Paying a very little to the Internet service provider anyone can share interests and activities across the borders. He can make his personal profile public before the entire online community. He can also look into other people's profile if he is interested. (e) The social networks are expanding so fast as most of them are cost free and complexity free. 3. question_text: 2. story- The story of Lipi
guide_solution: 2 Story: The Story of Lipi [Unit-5, Lesson-4] Questions: a. Who do you think helped Lipi from behind the scene succeed in cancelling her early marriage? b. Describe Tara Mia's father as a character in the story. c. What is the familial condition of Lipi? d. Why did Lipi's father want to marry her off at an early age? e. Do you agree that Lipi is a strong willed girl? Why? f. What was the purpose of the meeting called by the Head teacher of Lipi's school? g. What did the Head teacher explain in the meeting regarding Lipi's marriage? h. How did Tara Mia's father react to the Head teacher’s advocacy of cancelling Lipi's marriage? i. Who was Tara Mia? How was his family condition? j. How was Lipi's marriage called off? k. Discuss the impact of early marriage in 2/3 sentences. l. Why did the majority of the villagers support the Head teacher? m. How can Lipi's future be shattered? n. Who were present in the meeting? o. Why did the Headteacher intend to arrange a meeting? p.What was Lipi's response to her father's plan for her marriage? q. Why did Lipi's father want her to marry Tara Mia? r. What did the Headteacher do to help Lipi ? s. What was the outcome of the meeting? t. What does the story suggest about the role of education in Lipi's life? u. What does Lipi's story teach about the importance of community support ? → Answers: a. I think none but Lipi's mother helped her from behind the scene succeed in cancelling her early marriage. It is clearly evidenced by the statement "Her mother stood by her, though secretly." We can also find the evidence in the fact that it was only Lipi's father who wanted to marry her off. b. Tara Mia's father was an influential but inconsiderate person in the village, who possessed a few acres of land. In the meeting, he opposed others' opinion and argued that they were trying to deprive Lipi of the opportunity of having wealth and status in the society. In a word, he was injudicious in character. c. Lipi hails from a poor family. There are seven members in the family including three daughters and two sons. Her father is a day labourer and her mother is a part-time worker at other people's homes. The small income of her father is not sufficient to manage the large family. d. Lipi's father had a small income with which it was challenging for her parents to raise five children. Hence, her father probably wanted to lessen the burden of the large family by marrying her off. e. Yes, Lipi is a strong-willed girl because going against the decision of her father to marry her off, she managed to cancel the marriage with the help of the teachers and students of her school. Now, she is a student of Carmichael College. It has become possible because of her strong will. f. The purpose of the meeting called by the Headteacher of Lipi's school was to cancel the marriage of Lipi at too early an age. g. Hearing about Lipi's marriage, the Head teacher explained the dangerous consequences of early marriage in detail in the meeting. He informed that due to early marriage her education would come to an end. Also, she would face constant health hazards due to early pregnancy. Most importantly, her future life would be shattered for this. h. In respect to the Head teacher’s advocacy of cancelling Lipi's marriage, Tara Mia's father was not happy at all. He said that they were all making mistakes. Also, they were trying to deprive Lipi of the opportunity to have wealth and status in the society. i. Tara Mia was the only son of a farmer in the village. He was a widower,and illiterate person. But his family was solvent as his father had a few acres of cultivable land. j. When Lipi informed the teachers and students of her early marriage, the head teacher called a meeting to discuss it. All the attendees except Tara Mia's father were against Lipi's early marriage. So the marriage was called off. k. Early marriage has a number of negative impacts. Early marriage causes early pregnancy which causes serious health hazards. Again, due to early marriage, formal education is often stopped and a girl's dream is shattered. l. The majority of the villagers supported the Head teacher because they were convinced of the logic of the Head teacher and truly realized the adverse effects of the early marriage. m. Lipi's future can be shattered if she is married off at an early age. After marriage, her education will surely be stopped and that may shatter her dream. n. The teachers and students of Lipi's school, school managing committee members, some other respectable persons of the village, Lipi's father and Tara Mia's father were present in the meeting. o. The Headteacher intended to arrange a meeting to find a way of stopping Lipi's marriage. p. Hearing her father's plan for her marriage Lipi became greatly upset. She informed her parents that she was not ready to accept the marriage. Rather, she wanted to continue her education. q. Lipi's father wanted her to marry Tara Mia because he (Tara Mia) was well- off and had a few acres of arable land. So, Tara Mia's familial solvency and property allured Lipi's father to marry title her at an early age. r. To help Lipi the Headteacher organized a meeting with the teachers, students, school managing committee members and respected villagers to discuss the consequences of early marriage. s. The majority of the people at the meeting supported the Head teacher’s stance and Lipi's marriage was called off. t. The story highlights that Lipi valued education and was determined to pursue her education. For this she had to struggle against the pressures of early marriage. u. Lipi's story shows that with the support of the community, it is very possible to overcome oppressive and unfair situations like forced marriages. In this regard, the Head teacher and classmates and individuals can play a vital role to achieve their dreams.

Writing composition The Season I like Most Bangladesh is a small country but laden with natural beauty. Nature constantly changes from season to season. She has six seasons. Among them, the rainy season is very important. Ashar and Shraban are the months of the rainy season in Bangladesh according to Bangla calendar (বষর্পঞ্জি). I like this season very much. Monsoon (মৌসুমি বায়ু) blows in the rainy season. The south- west monsoon brings maximum water-vapour (জলীয় বাষ্ঙ্) during the months of June and July. The monsoon causes heavy rainfall during the rainy season. During the rainy season, the sky remains cloudy almost all the time. Sometimes, the sun is not visible for days together. During this time, it rains in torrents. Sometimes, it drizzles (টিপটিপ বৃষ্টি পড়া) for days together. Roads become muddy. Rivers, canals and ponds become full to the brim. They overflow their banks. Fields go under water. Village boys make rafts with banana trees and sticks. They like to roam here and there riding them. The rainy season is of great advantages. The current of rainwater carries silt which makes our soil fertile (উবর্র). Bangladesh is an agricultural country and most of the crops are dependent on rainwater. It helps paddy, jute, vegetables, sugarcane, tea and many other crops to grow. It washes away the filth and dirt from the earth's surface. It also purifies the atmosphere. Village people can easily go by boat from one place to another. We have a good supply of fish in this season. However, the rainy season is not wholly free from disadvantages. The poor suffer much during this season because they had no abode to protect them from rain. Moreover, much rainfall causes flood which damages our crops, washes away cattle and huts and causes much sufferings to the people. In fact, its economic value is very great. However, with all its merits and demerits, it is still a blessing for our country and this is why I like it most. 4. Writing paragraph An Ideal Student One who knows how to learn, read and write and above all, goes to an educational institute, is called a student. The student who prepares his lessons properly and regularly and avoids all those whe stand in the way of studies is called an ideal student. An ideal student should be studious. This is his foremost (প্রধান) duty. An ideal student must be well- behaved (সদাচরণ). He must be truthful and honest. He is obedient to his superiors. He also avoids so called students politics and all kinds of bad habits. He should say his five times prayers in time. As he is a citizen of the country, he should love his country and must be ready to dedicate (উৎসগর্) his life for the welfare of his country. An ideal student takes part in co-curricular (সহ-পাঠক্রম) activities. He also participates in games and sports. He should play in the playground at the proper time. He always make the proper use of time. He should not waste his valuable period by gossiping. He should take care of his health. A sound body develops a sound mind which helps him to prosper in life. He never shirks (কতর্ব্য এড়িয়ে চলা) his duty. His aim is to be great in life. He abides by the rules of discipline in all aspects (দিক) of life. An ideal student is not indifferent to his duties to society. He helps the poor, teaches the illiterate people and serves the distressed (দুদর্শাগ্রস্ঙ্) people. If an ideal student performs his duties properly for the shake of the country, he will become the pride of the nation. 15. Writing composition The Game I like most We can entertain ourselves and keep our body fit by playing games. In our country, we have many outdoor games such as football, cricket, hockey, tennis, ha-du-du, dariabandha etc. Some of them are our local games. Cricket, football, hockey are the games of other nations. However, they are becoming popular (জনপ্রিয়) day by day in our country. Of all these games, I like cricket most. Though cricket is a national game of Great Britain, it has become very popular in many other nations of the world like Pakistan, India, Australia, Newzealand, Srilanka, West Indies, Bangladesh and so on. I like the game because it teaches obedience, patience, perseverance (অধ্যবসায়), and co-operation. There are three catagories which are seen in cricket. These are test cricket, one-day cricket and twenty-twenty cricket. The game is played between two teams, each consisting of eleven members. A large portion of perfectly flat and smooth (মসৃণ) ground is necessary for this game. A cricket game must have a turf (ঘাসের চাপড়া) which must be kept soft by watering. A ball, two wooden bats and two sets of stumps are required for it. The wickets are pitched opposite and paralleled at a distance (দঙ্রত্ব) of 22 yards. First of all, the captains of two teams have to come forward and toss a coin to decide which team will bat or bowl first. After the toss, the game proceeds on. A run is said to be scored when the batsman after hitting the ball changes position once with his partner before the ball is received at the wickets. If the ball crosses (অতিক্রম করা) the boundary, four runs are made. If it flies over the boundary line, six runs are made. When the ball hits the stumps, the batsman is said to be bowled out and when the ball rises up after hitting and then if it is caught, he is caught out. Again, if the ball is thrown against the stumps while batsman is running, he is run out. I think that cricket is an interesting and exciting game. It is the game of patience, perseverance and co-operation. Fairness is the very essence (নিযার্স)of this game. For all these, I like the game most. Second Paper  Solutions

Writing paragraph A rickshaw puller A rickshaw-puller is a poor day-labourer who earns his livelihood by pulling a rickshaw. He carries passengers and goods from one place to another on payment. Very often, he drives the rickshaw of others. In Bangladesh, we see them very often in different cities. We find them in front of the school, college, shopping-mall and park. A rickshaw-puller works from dawn to dusk and even to the later part of the night. He does not care about the condition of the weather. He has to pull his rickshaw despite foul weather. He is generally gentle by nature. Some rickshaw-pullers try to cheat the passengers. Sometimes, they demand high fare. A rickshaw-puller generally lives in a slum area. He has to live from hand to mouth as he earns too little to support his family. If he falls sick, he and his family members fall in distress. To support his family, he has to pull the rickshaw despite his sickness. In fact, his life is full of sufferings.

Made Easy to SSC English Test Papers 15. Writing composition Student life and social service It is society which is associated with all classes of people with common interest, aim and principle. Students are not separated from society. They are also social beings like other classes of people. They enjoy the same social benefits, rights and privileges (সুযোগ-সুবিধা). As a member of society students must have something to do for their society. Students service is particularly important in poor countries like ours. Student life is the period for education and training. It is not desirable that students should waste their time and energies in affairs other than education. But living in a developing country like ours students have to render certain services for the development and progress of the nation. Students are in the process of learning and they can share their acquired knowledge with the illiterate and deprived citizens of our country. They may run night schools and teach the poor and working children as well as the uneducated adult people. If that is not possible, they can at least teach servants in their own house. Besides teaching the three R’s—Reading, Writing and Arithmetic students can also teach the people about modern methods of cultivation, the use of fertilizers and proper caring of crops. They can also provide advice on earning methods, for example, whether to dig a pond for fish cultivation (বঞ্চিত নাগরিক) or to make a farm. Students have duties towards society no doubt, but they should not remain always preoccupied with these. They should render social services during leisure time or during long vacations. Students can take part in raising awareness regarding population problem. Population is growing in geometrical progression. If this growth remains unchecked the economic security of the country will be at a stake (ভীষণ বিপদ). The illiterate people of our country are full of prejudices (বিদ্বেষ) and do not feel the necessity of family planning. Students may come forward to remove these evil conceptions of the people. They can teach people the problems of overpopulation and should encourage them to adopt the measures of family planning. Students services are necessary in the field of our national wealth. They can play an important role. Female student can teaches the uneducated women how to keep their houses neat and clean, hold to bring up children and look after their health. The village people and the people living in the slums (বস্ঙ্)িsuffer from many diseases. They have no knowledge about health and environment. The students can teach them about the basic rules of health and environment. Students can prove to be worthy during natural calamities. In times of flood, famine, cyclone, earthquake and epidemic they can come forward to help the people in distress. They can collect food, clothes and medicine and distribute them amongst the people in need. Students are the servants of society. They are the makers of society. They are the soldiers of social peace. They should serve the society without any selfish motive. But in doing so, they should not forget that proper attention should be given to their education. Writing composition A Postman In the past people used to live at home with their kith and kin. But with the advancement of civilization man now lives far from his families and relatives. So he has to remain anxious for news from near and dear ones. This demand has been met up through the introduction of postal system. Thus, the service of the postman comes into being. The postman is employed by the postal department to deliver postal matters like letters, parcels, money orders etc to the addressees. In our daily life the postman is the most familiar figure. Everyday at a particular time he is seen passing through the streets. He is the most eagerly waited person. Our heart swells with expectations when we see him approaching our doors. He brings news from our near and dear ones living in home and abroad. The postman renders invaluable service to us . He attends the office in time and performs his duties sincerely. If he fails to discharge his duties properly any day, it may cause irreparable loss to the persons concerned. In all weathers good and bad he performs his duty. The postman starts his work in the post office. He opens the mail bag and sorts the letters and other postal articles. He hands over the outgoing mail to the runner. Then he starts of this own round. But in the town the postman imaginations an official air. He moves very fast from door to door and quietly drops the letters into the letter boxes. If he finds a house without letter box, he drops down the letters through the doors or windows. In delivering registered parcels, money orders etc. he calls the addressees. The service of the post man is of great importance to us, but he is very much neglected. He is ill paid and can hardly make both ends. He is not held in due respect. It is open to students as well as to teachers. It is a place for research (গবেষণা) too. The students who want to read books go to library. A school library bears a great importance to a school. A school without a library is like a garden without flower. In fact, a school is incomplete without a library. Normally, a school library is located beside the teachers' room or academic building. The books are arranged in alphabetical order within a specific subject in a school library. Each and every student is given a library card by the librarian. Writing composition Importance of reading Newspaper The importance of reading newspapers can not be described in some words or lines. Newspaper is the storehouse of knowledge. The chief business of a newspapers is to give us news which we need to know. It tells us what happens at home and abroad. The modern civilized people cannot do without reading newspapers. Venice in Europe was the first city to introduce newspaper. India Gazette was the first Bengali newspaper of this sub continent. There are many kinds of newspaper, such as daily, weekly, fortnightly and monthly. Most of the people read the dailies, because they carry for us fresh and current news of the day. They also contain the views expressed by great leaders and thinkers of the world on current topics. The monthlies contain articles, stories, literature and poems. The newspaper is a useful means of both pleasure and education. It tells us what is going on in our country as well as in foreign countries. It keeps us information of the latest discoveries. In brief, it is the summary of current history. The politicians, businessmen, scientists, doctors, economists-all learn the news of their own interest from a newspaper. The government gathers public opinion regarding any subject of political interest through a newspaper and frames policies accordingly. The businessmen learn about the ups and downs of the market prices. A newspaper has also some demerits. A newspaper often publishes false news or sometimes it exaggerates things. We should remain careful about such news. We should patronize the publication of a few more newspapers in our country. Second Paper  Solutions

Writing paragraph Global Warming The process by which the air surrounding the earth is becoming warmer day by day is known as the Greenhouse Effect. It is the ultimate result of different types of environmental pollution. The huge emission (নিঃসরণ) of carbon dioxide gas is primarily responsible for this. Again, deforestation around the world adds to the problem. Owing to the increased amount of heat around the world, the polar (মেরু) ice-caps have already started melting which may eventually lead to a rise in sea levels causing flood to many areas of the world. Owing to global warming which the river water becomes salty and the farmland around will lose fertility (উবর্রতা). Man's ability to grow crops will decrease and there will be a crisis of food. Many species of animals and plants are endangered with the threat of extinction. So it is high time men could understand the threat of the greenhouse effect. To prevent global warming, we need to take immediate steps. Tree plantation programme should be made more popular. The deliberate cutting of trees must be stopped. The sources of greenhouse gases should be controlled. We should raise public awareness about the adverse impacts of the Greenhouse Effect. 234 15. The Samachar Darpan is the first Bengali Newspaper which is published Christian missionaries of Srerampore. Now those days are gone by. Man has invented printing machine. Thousands of newspapers are being printed daily all over the world.

Writing composition Your Favourite Hobby Hobby means one's favourite (প্রিয়) occupation (বৃত্তি), but not one's main business (প্রধান পেশা). A man does not depend on it for his living (জীবিকা) but it is not less important than his main business. Every man has his own hobby. It is an interesting way (আনন্দদায়ক পন্থা) to enjoy our leisure period. There are many kinds of hobbies like gardening, drawing picture, painting, kite flying, stamp collecting (টিকিট সংগ্রহ করা), fishing etc. Whatever be one's hobby, it offers one pleasure and relieves from monotony (একঘেয়েমি). I am a student. I also have a hobby. It is gardening. My garden is in front of my bed room. I have planted (রোপণ করেছি) many kinds of seasonal flower plants in it. I work there with a spade (কোদাল) during my leisure (অবসর). I make the soil loose, weed out the grass and plant (রোপণ করি) new flower plants. I water (পানি দেওয়া) them regularly. There is a strong fence (বেড়া) around my garden so that the naughty boys and animals can do no harm to my flower plants. I also set up a scarecrow in the garden so that birds can't do any harm to my plants. I like gardening because it is very useful for health and mind. It is a sort of physical exercise. It strengthens (শক্তিশালী করে) my health and refreshes (সতেজ করা) my mind. Everyday I get great pleasure when I see the blooming flowers in the garden. I am charmed at their beauty when they are tossed (নাড়া দেওয়া) by gentle breeze (বাতাস). I also get pleasure when the sweet scent of flowers come into my room. Besides this, I grow some vegetables in my garden. This saves a lot of expenses of my family. For a cheerful (আনন্দময়) life every man should have a hobby. But we should see that our main works are not hampered (ব্যাহত না হয়) on account of it. (b) The air raids against ISIS came after first major cross border clashes. Writing composition A journey you have Recently Made Since Bangladesh is a riverine country, travelling by boat is an everyday affair in Bangladesh. Here waterways are the prime (প্রধান) means of communication (যোগাযোগ). It was the last summer vacation when one morning Kader, a bosom (ঘনিষ্ঠ) friend of mine, knocked at my door and wanted me to accompany him on a boat trip to his village. I readily agreed. Soon we four friends named Kader, Asif, Akbar, and I were on the quiet stream of the river. As both the wind and the stream were favourable (অনুকূল), our boat sped swiftly, making its way along the surface of water with great ease. We left behind the chaotic (কোলাহলপঙ্ণর্) town and heaved a sigh of relief. The green banks with cluster of trees charmed (মুগ্ধ করা) our eyes. The far off paddy fields as well as jute fields unfolded their green bosoms. The thatched cottages of the villagers with clusters of trees around them offered a very charming sight. Farmers were going to their fields to plough their land, village boys were playing there and shy (লাজুক) peasant women were drawing water at another place. We became spellbound to see the beautiful rural landscape. In an hour and a half the boat reached a market. We halted (থামা) there and got down. We bought rice, eggs, a large Hilsa and some sweetmeat of different kinds. We had a desire to enjoy the boat journey thoroughly. With this desire in mind, we started making arrangements (ব্যবস্থা) for cooking our meals. The boatmen supplied us with ovens (চুলি-) and we collected fuel from the neighbourhood. The boatmen offered to cook the food for us but we did not take any help from them. We began cooking the food ourselves. We boiled rice, prepared omelettes and also cooked fish curry. The healthy river breeze and the movement in the market place and the village nearby had stimulated our appetite (ক্ষুধা). So, we ate our food with great relish. At about two o'clock in the afternoon, we launched our boat again. The boatmen tried hard to reach the destination (গন্ঙ্ব্যস্থল) before sunset but they failed. The beauty of the golden sunset on the calm water of the river made pleasant impression on our young minds. The shades of evening now began to spread over the earth. The stars made their appearance in the sky slowly one after another. The dim light of the lamp which the villagers had lighted came to our sight through the groves of trees. A stray jackal sent out a cry and he was immediately joined by his fellows who set up chorus announcing (ঘোষণা করা) the approach of the night. The boat moved on slowly until it reached our destination. It touched at the ghat of Kader's house. By then, it was dark all around. We walked to Kader's house which was a stone's throw from the riverside. I've several journeys in my life. But the above stated journey makes a good impression on my mind. Every moment of that journey is memorable. I will never forget it. 2. Writing paragraph Load-shedding 'Load-shedding' means the discontinuation (বন্ধ) of the supply of electricity. It is disgusting (বিরক্তির উদ্রেক করছে) in our civil life. I feel very uneasy at the time of load- shedding. When it occurs at night, the whole environment becomes seriously (মারাত্মকভাবে) dark. In this time, thieves and pick-pocketers freely prowl on the street. I don't do any task at that moment. Most of the time of load-shedding takes place at night and I spend my time at our balcony (বারান্দা) sitting on a chair. It hampers my study. In a day, it occurs twice or more. It lasts minimum 30 to 40 minutes. The failure of electricity hampers (ব্যাহত করে) productivity (উৎপাদনশীলতা). Domestic life becomes painful. The sufferings of the students due to load-shedding beggar description. The patients also suffer terribly for load- shedding. Operations in the hospitals are stopped. The food kept in the refrigerators get rotten. The commodities (পণ্যদ্রব্যাদি) preserved in cold storage get spoiled. In fact, load-shedding causes great sufferings to the people and an irrepairable loss to the country. The entire (সম্ঙ্ঙ্ণর্) life whether domestic and industrial comes to a standstill. There are many causes which are responsible for load- shedding. The misuse of electricity, the unpayment of the bill, undevelopment in the power sector, corruption, illegal connection are the main causes of load-shedding. So the government should take necessary steps to control the load- shedding. He should take proper steps to set up more generation plants to produce adequate energy and to distribute the energy in a planned way. Besides, illegal connections of electricity lines should be disrupted and system loss should be reduced to the minimum. Proper punishment should be executed for the corrupted officers and illegal connectors. 15. Writing composition Duties of a student See NKM High School and Homes, Narsingdi. Sl. Writing composition Discipline Disicipline may be defined as strict obedience to certain rules and regulation. Discipline in student life is something like a capital without which no progress and prosperity can be achieved. Students are taught to maintain discipline at schools and colleges. The students have to follow certain codes of behaviour which reading or playing. Much of a man's success depends on his disciplined activities. A well disciplined student life is a successful life. Discipline should be maintained at all costs in the institutions. The students must be disciplined. The first and foremost duty of a student is to acquire knowledge. A student should remember that knowledge is power. He should read not only his prescribed books, but also the books of famous writers to follow their discipline in life. He has to fix his aim of life and make himself fit for that profession. He should keep in mind that the student of today is the leaders of the nation in future. The importance of discipline cannot be overemphasized. In all organizations, religious, political, economic, social or educational, rules and regulation must be observed. Life without discipline is like a ship without a rudder. In the absence of discipline, only chaos and anarchy prevail in any section of life. So, we must maintain discipline in every sphere of our life. It is an essential precondition for the growth of society and the spread of civilization. 6. Writing Paragraph A Tea Stall A tea stall is a small shop where ready tea is mainly served to the customers. Some dry foods like biscuits, cakes and different kinds of hand made snacks are also served here. A tea stall is found almost everywhere. We can see a tea stall in the corners of the streets, near office or factory, steamer or launch ghat or in the platforms of railway station. A tea stall is usually found in a village hat and bazar. In a tea stall, there are a few chairs, tables or benches for the customers to sit on and enjoy tea. There is often a boy or two to serve tea to the customers. In a tea stall, the manager doesn't have any specific place to sit on. But, generally, he sits beside the cashbox. Generally the customers go to him and pay him the bill. But sometimes, the boys of his stall collect the money and give it to him. It is a place for gossip, rest and recreation (বিনোদন). It is frequently visited by the weary passers-by, the tired office assistants, the fatigued (ক্লান্ঙ্) labourers, the exhausted rickshaw-pullers as well as the students and political workers. They go on gossipping in groups on any kind of subjects. Someone reads newspaper, others discuss politics and other matters. Sometimes, people raise a storm in a teacup. It is in fact, a pleasure resort for people of all age groups and of all walks of life. The quality and standard (মান) of tea stalls vary from place to place according to the status of the locality where they are run. A tea stall opens early in the morning and is kept close at midnight (মধ্যরাত্রি) and it remains busy because customers come every now and then. 15. It stands on sixty stone pillars with its seventy seven Gambuj or domes and not shat or sixty gambuj as the name suggests (নিদের্শ করা). Some say that it was used as a mosque by Khan Jahan Ali. Others say that it was used as a court by the Mughal Governor of the place. However, it is associated more with Saint Khan Jahan Ali's name than with the name of the Governor (শাসক). It attracts a large number of tourists and visitors every year. There is also a lake-like sweet water tank by the side of Shat Gambuj Mosque. Its length is more than double its breadth. It is said that before digging it, a horse was made to run a race. It ran straight covering a certain distance. That distance was accepted as the length of the dighi. That is why; the dighi was named Ghora Dighi. This dighi also has its own crocodiles. We spent about five hours in visiting these two places of historical interest. We saw and enjoyed the architectural beauty and natural scenery (প্রাকৃতিক দৃশ্য) of the place. We were surprised and overwhelmed. Writing Formal letter 18 August, 2015 The Headmaster, River View High School, Rajshahi Subject : Request for the establishment of an English Language Club. Sir, We, the students of your school, beg to state that our school is a renowned one. But it is a matter of great regret that we hardly find any opportunity to develop our spoken English for want of an English Language Club. Generally, we pass our leisure time in vain. But if there is a language club, we can exercise conversation in English among us in a suitable atmosphere. Even we can organise an English debate. We, therefore, beg to pray and hope that you would be kind enough to take necessary steps for the establishment of an English Language Club at our school at your earliest convenience. Yours obediently, Sultana Class X On behalf of the students of River View High School 14. Writing Paragraph The Life of a Farmer A farmer is the man who cultivates the land and grows crops. He is the main agent of our agriculture. A farmer is the pioneer of our agricultural (কৃষিজ)system. We cannot expect farming and production without the labour of our farmers. He grows and provides food for the people of our country. A farmer lives in a village. He leads a very simple life. He works from dawn (ভোর) to dusk. Rising in the morning, a farmer eats some 'panta bhat' or watered rice and goes to work in the field. If he has no food in the house, he goes without food. But he must work in the field in fair and foul weather. He tills the land and prepares the field for sowing seeds or transplanting (চারা লাগানো) seedlings. He earns so little that he cannot maintain his family well. He is often helped by his children. Though a farmer works very hard, he leads a hard life. He does not get fair price of his crops. He lives in a hut or cottage. A farmer lives in want. A landless farmer leads a very miserable life. Though a farmer is generally a very poor man, he is very soft-minded. He is very happy if there is a good harvest. But his sorrows know no bounds if there is a bad harvest (ফসল). As agriculture is the main source of our economy, we should do our best to improve the lot of our farmers. The government should take steps to educate them and help them with good seed, fertilizer and better agricultural knowledge. 15. Writing composition My Future Plan of Life See Comilla Cadet College. Writing application 18 January, 2015 The Headmaster Rajshahi Zilla School Subject : Application for setting up a canteen in the school campus. Sir, This is to inform you that ours is one of the most famous schools in the city, but it is a matter of great regret that there is no canteen in our school campus. Writing composition The Journey which I like the best A journey is always interesting. Everyone wants to make a journey. But it is more exciting (উত্তেজনাকর) and attractive (আকষর্ণীয়) to a student as it provides him with an opportunity to escape from the daily routine in life. I was therefore, looking forward to the commencement (সঙ্চনা) of the summer vacation when I would get an opportunity (সুযোগ) to have a long journey. The summer vacation of my school was getting near. I had decided to spend this vacation (ছুটি) with my uncle at Chittagong. One of my cousins also agreed to accompany (সঙ্গে যাওয়া)me. We decided to go to Chittagong by train. Train journey seems to me very comfortable (আরামদায়ক) and enjoyable. The day of my journey drew near and our excitement ran high. At last, the day of our journey came. We arranged everything for the journey. My father managed two first class tickets for us. We reached the Kamlapur Railway Station in the morning. We were waiting for the train. My parents and aunt were with us to see us off. We occupied a comfortable room in the first class cabin. When time came, the train started off and we jumped in excitement. We heaved a sigh of relief. The train started running at a good speed and soon we were far from the din and bustle of the city. We kept the window open and a gentle breeze (বাতাস) of the open space cooled the room. The train was running through green fields. There were paddy, jute and sugarcane plants here and there. They were tossing (দোলানো) their heads in the breeze. I started reading a novel of Rabindranath and enjoying the scene. Our train stopped only at junctions, as it was a mail train. The choose of the passengers boarding the train or getting down, the shouting of the hawkers and the movement of staffs were an exciting sight. The majesty of the setting sun and the pathos (করুণ রস) of the departing day can be best seen from a train. The slow approach (আগমন) of darkness, the gradual and majestic setting of the sun, the flying flock 252 of birds in search of nightly shelters all are charming sights. All the way I was either looking outside or reading the novels. Nothing was visible except some darker patches at intervals. They were the homesteads or bushes and groves. In Bangladesh a devastating flood occured in 1283 of the Bengali year. After this many floods visited Bangladesh, but none was so serious as the floods of 1954 and 1955. Next flood occured in 1958. The flood of 1970 caused by the tidal surge was a deluge (gnvc-veb). Then the fearful floods took place in 1974 and 1988. No sooner had the wound been healed up than the flood of 1998 befell. The flood of 1998 is the most remarkable in the century because it lasted for almost three months. Flood causes a lot of devastation (ধ্বংস). It destroys our life and property. It washes away villages, towns, everything. Roads and houses go under water. Trees are uprooted. It damages our crops and renders people homeless. They take refuge (আশ্রয় নেওয়া) in schools, colleges, and in relief camps. The after effects of flood are very terrible. People suffer greatly for want of food, pure drinking water, shelter and medicine. Cholera, typhoid, dysentery break out in an epidemic form. (মহামারি আকারে) The prices of daily commodities go high and people cannot buy them. In spite of the devastation, there are a few useful sides of flood. Flood water carries silt (পলি) that increases the fertility of land. Flood water washes away dirt and filth (নোংড়া জিনিস) and helps cleaning our environment and the surrounding areas. To remain unaffected from flood, the following measures can be adopted: By building up dams and embankments (বাঁধ ও বেড়ি বাঁধ), the crops of the low lying areas can be saved. There should be profuse tree plantation of these embankments so that the onrush (প্রচণ্ড ধাক্কা) of flood water cannot make a breach in them. The rivers should be dredged (খনন করা) to keep their normal flow and to allow water to go down to the sea. To reserve water in the rainy season to use in the dry season, reservoirs should be made. This will save us from flood and at the same it will help to grow crops in the dry season. Flood is a natural calamity. To guard against flood we should undertake those measures that the developed countries have already taken. Our govt. should improve flood protection measures. At any cost we have to innovate newer and permanent ways to save our country, economy and people from the devastation of flood. 3. Making sentences (a) Robinson Crusoe ran away from home one day. Writing composition Physical Exercise Physical exercise means the correct movement of the limbs of our body according to certain rules. It is important to keep our body fit and mind sound. Physical exercise helps us to remain fit and sound. Physical exercise is of various kinds. Good forms of exercise include walking, riding, racing, rowing, swimming, gymnastics, wrestling and playing many outdoor and indoor games. All forms of exercise are not suitable (উপযোগী) for all ages. If an old man takes part in a football game or hockey, he will get tired. It does no good to him. Those who are strong and stout (বলিষ্ঠ) can take all forms of exercise. On the other hand, those who are weak cannot take all forms of exercise. Walking is the best kind of exercise for all in all circumstances (অবস্থা). It is of special use to the weak and the old. Walking in the morning and evening refreshes (সতেজ করে) our body and mind. It also enables a man to enjoy the scenic (মনোরম নৈসগির্ক দৃশ্য সংবলিত)beauty of nature. Swimming is also a good exercise. It strengthens (বলবান করা) all the limbs of our body. Gymnastic exercises are not suited to the people of all ages. The weak and the old cannot stand the strains of gymnastic exercises. Gymnastic exercises are best suited to the young, students and members of well organised clubs. Riding, racing, rowing, wrestling, indoor and outdoor games offer simple opportunity (সুযোগ) for the exercise of our body. Among all forms of exercise, swimming and walking are the best because they cost nothing. An oft-quoted proverb (প্রবাদ) goes that a sound mind lives in a sound body. Mere the acquisition (অজর্ন) of knowledge without a sound health is of no use to society. There lies a close connection (সম্ঙ্কর্)between the body and mind. If the body is unsound (অসুস্থ), the mind must be unsound. We cannot think of a sound mind without a sound health. It is physical exercise, which enables us to build a good health which is the key to success. There are many people who do not take physical exercise. They do not realize that they themselves are ruining (ক্ষতি করা) their health. They fall a victim (শিকার) to many diseases. Life becomes dull (নিষ্ঙ্রাণ) to them. They are always peevish (খিটখিটে) and ill tempered. We can build a good health and a sound mind through physical exercise. Physical exercise makes our body active and the muscles (মাংসপেশী) strong. It also improves (উন্নত করা) our power of digestion (হজম) and blood circulation. It gives strength to our brain. Many good habits are formed through outdoor games. It teaches us unity, patience (সহিষ্ণুতা), obedience, discipline and punctuality (সময়নিষ্ঠতা). 3. Making sentences (a) Travelling is always fascinating. (b) It has educative value as well. Writing composition My Favourite Sport We can entertain ourselves and keep our body fit by playing games. In our country, we have many outdoor games such as football, cricket, hockey, tennis, ha-du-du, dariabandha etc. Some of them are our local games. Cricket, football, hockey are the games of other nations. However, they are becoming popular (জনপ্রিয়) day by day in our country. Of all these games, I like cricket most. Though cricket is a national game of Great Britain, it has become very popular in many other nations of the world like Pakistan, India, Australia, Newzealand, Srilanka, West Indies, Bangladesh and so on. I like the game because it teaches obedience, patience, perseverance (অধ্যবসায়), and co- operation. There are three catagories which are seen in cricket. These are test cricket, one-day cricket and twenty-twenty cricket. The game is played between two teams, each consisting of eleven members. A large portion of perfectly flat and smooth (মসৃণ) ground is necessary for this game. A cricket game must have a turf (ঘাসের চাপড়া) which must be kept soft by watering. A ball, two wooden bats and two sets of stumps are required for it. The wickets are pitched opposite and paralleled at a distance (দঙ্রত্ব)of 22 yards. First of all, the captains of two teams have to come forward and toss a coin to decide which team will bat or bowl first. After the toss, the game proceeds on. A run is said to be scored when the batsman after hitting the ball changes position once with his partner before the ball is received at the wickets. If the ball crosses (অতিক্রম করা) the boundary, four runs are made. If it flies over the boundary line, six runs are made. When the ball hits the p stumps, the batsman is said to be bowled out and when the ball rises up after hitting and then if it is caught, he is caught out. Again, if the ball is thrown against the stumps while batsman is running, he is run out. I think that cricket is an interesting and exciting game. It is the game of patience, perseverance and co-operation. Fairness is the very essence (নিযার্স) of this game. For all these, I like the game most. 4. Writing paragraph Physical Exercise Physical exercise means movement of our limbs. A human body is not a machine. A machine can be kept in a place without movement. But the human body must be moved and stirred (চালানো) up. Otherwise, it turns to be inactive and immobile (অচল). And so physical exercise is very important. It makes our health active and mobile. If health is well, mind is well because of the fact that health is the soundness of body as well as the soundness of mind. In fact, there is the close relationship between mind and body. Physical exercise helps one to remove lethargy (আলস্য)and numbness (অনুভূতিশঙ্ন্যতা). It helps one to free one's health from illness and sickness. It keeps mind and body safe and sound by offering stamina and strength. It makes one's muscles strong and energetic. In fact, it keeps body fit by removing weakness and feebleness (দুবর্লতা). To keep body hale and hearty, one should also take a balanced diet. One should drink clean water to keep fit. By keeping fit, one can be productive because of the fact that a healthy person is an asset to the country. He or she can play an important role in the development programmes of the country. Now it has occupied a place in the Olympic Games.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : টমাস আলভা এডিসন ১৮৪৭ সালে আমেরিকার ওহিওতে জন্মগ্রহণ করেন। একজন ছোট্ট বালক হিসেবে তিনি খুব অনুসন্ধিৎসু ছিলেন। তিনি সব সময়ই জানতে চাইতেন কীভাবে সবকিছু হয়ে থাকে। (চার পাশের ঘটনাগুলো কিভাবে বা কী জন্য ঘটে)। জীবনের খুব অল্প বয়সেই তিনি দেখিয়েছিলেন যে তার জানার আগ্রহ ছিল খুব বেশি; যে গুণটি আবিষ্কারকদের নিকট খুবই প্রয়োজনীয়। ১৮৬৯ সালে তিনি নিউইয়কের্ যান এবং সেখানে কিছুদিন টেলিফোন অপারেটর হিসাবে কাজ করেন। কিন্তু খুব শিগগিরই তিনি আবিষ্কারের জন্যে আগ্রহী হয়ে উঠেন। আর গবেষণা চালিয়ে যাবার জন্য অল্প সময়ের মধ্যেই তিনি মেনলো পাকের্ একটি গবেষণাগার নিমার্ণ করেন। তার প্রথম বড় আবিষ্কার ছিল টেলিগ্রাফীর একটি প্রক্রিয়া। তারপর তিনি ফনোগ্রাফ আবিষ্কার করেন।(ফনোগ্রাফ হলো আজকের Record Player; Record Player-এর পুরনো ইংরেজি হলো phonograph) ফনোগ্রাফ হলো যে যন্ত্রকে আমরা গ্রামোফোন বা রেকডের্প-য়ার হিসাবে চিনি তার সবর্প্রথম রূপ। ফনোগ্রাফ শব্দের অথর্ হলো এমন কিছু যা লিখতে পারে বা শব্দ রেকডর্ করতে পারে। এডিসনের পুবের্ও অন্যান্য বিজ্ঞানীরা এই ধরনের যন্ত্র নিয়ে গবেষণা করেছেন যা সুÿ্মভাবে কাজ করেছিল। তিনি(এডিসন) 'ইনকেনডিসেন্ট' বাতিও আবিষ্কার করেন; এটা এমন এক ধরনের বাতি যে বাতিতে উত্তপ্ত তার থেকে প্রচুর আলো সৃষ্টি হয়; উত্তপ্ত তারটির নাম হলো "ফিলামেন্ট"। বিদ্যুৎ দ্বারা তারটিকে উত্তপ্ত করা হয়। মানুষ এখন সেই বৈদ্যুতিক বাতি ব্যবহার করে তাদের বাড়ি-ঘর আলোকিত করছে। ১৯৩১ সালে যখন তিনি মারা যান সে সময়ের মধ্যে তিনি প্রায় এক হাজারটি আবিষ্কার সম্পন্ন করার গৌরব অজর্ন করেন। 4. The worst of all the problems that affect all the flora and fauna (উিদ্্ভদ ও প্রাণিকুল) of our environment is the climate change. The mangrove forest will be affected because of increasing salinity (লবণাক্ততা) during the winter season and high tides at monsoon. Story writing Once there lived a woodcutter in a village near a jungle. He used to cut wood from the forest and sold them to market. One day, he was cutting wood near a river. Suddenly, his axe fell into the river. The woodcutter did not know how to swim or dive. He was sitting there sadly and a wonderful thing happened. A beautiful fairy appeared before the woodcutter and asked him in a sweet voice, "Why are you so sad? Why are you not cutting wood?" The woodcutter replied sorrowfully, "My axe has fallen into the pond. I can't cut wood now." The fairy took pity on him. She went into the river and came back with an exe. The fairy then showed him the axe made of silver. She asked him if it was his axe. The woodcutter saw the axe and said, "No it's not my axe." She then again went into the water and returned with an axe. The fairy showed him another axe made of gold. She asked, "Is this the axe that you lost?" The woodcutter again said, "No, it's not. My axe is made of iron. It was old." Finally, she brought the axe of the woodcutter, from the water. She showed him the lost axe with a wooden handle. The woodcutter then said happily that it was his axe. The fairy became very pleased with the honesty of the woodcutter and gave him the gold and the silver axes as reward. Then, the woodcutter became rich and began to live happily. So, we must keep in mind that honesty is always rewarded.  Title : An honest woodcutter 10. We are hopeful, if this positive trend in the literacy rate of our country continues, our country will go ahead in the days to come. 11. Answering questions (a) Smuggling continued as before though there were government officials to cheek it because bribing was rampant there. Summary : Alfred Harvey was a young custom house officer. There was smuggling all around the town where he worked. A lot of government officials were appointed to check smuggling but for bribery it was not possible. It was Alfred Harvey who became successful in that case though he was threatened several times by the smugglers. For his honesty and dutifulness, he got appreciation from his chiefs and got promoted. Now he is more adventurous than before.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : শহীদুল-াহ কায়সার ১৯২৭ সালের ১৬ ফেব্রম্নয়ারি জন্মগ্রহণ করে। তিনি ছিলেন একজন বাংলাদেশি ঔপন্যাসিক ও লেখক। কায়সার মজুপুর গ্রামে(বতর্মানে ফেনী জেলায়) আবু নাঈম মোহাম্মদ শহীদুল-াহ নামে জন্মগ্রহণ করেন। তিনি কলকাতা প্রেসিডেন্সি কলেজে পড়াশোনা করেন এবং অর্থনীতিতে সম্মানসহ স্নাতক ডিগ্রি অজর্ন করেন। পরবতীর্ তিনি কলকাতা বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ে স্নাতকোত্তর শ্রেণীতে ভতির্ হন কিন্তু তা সম্পন্ন করতে পারেন নি। কায়সার ছাত্রজীবন থেকে রাজনীতি ও সাংস্কৃতিক কমর্কাণ্ডে সক্রিয় ছিলেন। ১৯৪৭ সালে পাকিস্@ান গঠন হওয়ার পর তিনি পুবর্ পাকিস্@ানের প্রাদেশিক কমিউনিস্ট পাটিের্ত(সমাজতান্ত্রিক দল) যোগ দেন। তিনি ১৯৪৯ সালে ঢাকায় ইত্তেফাক পত্রিকায় সাংবাদিক হিসেবে কাজ শুরম্ন করেন। ১৯৫২ সালের ভাষা আন্দোলনে তিনি সক্রিয়ভাবে অংশ্রহণ করেন। বাংলা ভাষা রÿার আন্দোলনে রাজনৈতিক ভূমিকার কারণে ১৯৫২ সালের ৩ জুন কায়সারকে গ্রেফতার করা হয়। পরে তাকে সাড়ে তিন বচরের কারাদন্ড দেওয়া হয়। ১৯৫৫ সালে জেল থেকে ছাড়া পাওয়ার ঠিক পর মুহুতের্ রাজনৈতিক ধ্বংসাত্মকমুলক কমর্কান্ডের অভিযোগে তাকে আবারও গ্রেফতার করে জেলে পাঠানো হয়। কয়েক বছর পর তিনি মুক্তি পান। ১৯৫৮ সালে তিনি সহযোগী সম্পাদক হিসেবে দৈনিত সংবাদে(বাংলা ভাষার দৈনিক) যোগদান করেন এবং বাকি জীবন তিনি সেখানে কাজ করেন। ১৯৫৮ সালের সামরিক অভ্যোত্থানে আইয়ুব খান ÿমতায় এসে মাশার্ল ল' জারি করলে, ১৯৫৮ সালের ১৪ অক্টোবর কায়সারকে আবারও আটক করা হয় এবং ১৯৬২ সালের সেপ্টেম্বর মাসে মুক্তি পাওয়ার পুবর্ পযর্ন্@ তিনি চার বছর জেলে বন্দী থাকেন। ১৯৭১ সালে বাংলাদেশের স্বাধীনতা যুদ্ধের শেষ ভাগে, পাকিস্@ানি সেনাবাহিনী এবং এর স্থানীয় সহযোগীরা মিলে শীষর্স্থানীয় বাঙালি বুদ্ধিজীবীদের হত্যা করার পরিকল্পনা করেছিল। এর অংশ হিসেবে কায়সারকে ১৯৭১ সালের ১৪ ডিসেম্বর উঠিয়ে নিয়ে যাওয়া হয়েছিল। তিনি আর কখনো ফিরে আসেন নি, কিংবা তার দেহ কখনো পাওয়া যায় নি। Made Easy to SSC English Test Papers 4. (b) + (vi) She has no light of its own. (c) + (vii) The sun pours forth a vast flood of light. (d) + (ii) To illuminate the earth the moon reflects a small fraction of brightness. (e) + (i) The moon's light depends on the gift of the sun. 7. Reordering sentences (h) + (d) + (c) + (e) + (g) + (f) + (a) + (b) Section B : Writing Test 8. Paragraph writing Merits and demerits of internet for the juvenile Internet is the latest means of communication. It is a computer based international networking system. It has many merits and demerits for its users. If the users are juvenile and if they are students, they can read books of various interests by going on the internet. They can collect different types of academic information from the internet. They can know about the information of different colleges and universities of different countries by using the internet. They can gather information like the life history of different famous personalities, different countries, health and nutrition, physical exercises and so on by going on the internet. But the demerits of the internet for the juvenile are that most of the juvenile spend their valuable time by surfing the internet. They enter the various bad sites of internet and lose their valuable time, energy, money and health. Sometimes the juvenile become mentally aberrant and sexually excited. Some of them pass a sleepless night by surfing the internet. For the internet some young people has become lazy. They have no time to play in the field. Always they are busy with surfing the internet on their mobile phone or computer. So in fine we can say that the internet has many advantages and disadvantages and its advantages and disadvantages absolutely depend on the proper use and abuse by the juvenile. 9. Story writing While returning home a farmer and a snake half dead lying in the field. He took it home and placed it by the fire side. He then gave it warm milk and made the snake sound. When the snake became well, he began to play with the children of the farmer. The children got pleasure to play with the snake. But the snake was wicked to the backbone, a while playing one day with the children of the farmer, he bit one of them. At this the farmer became very angry. Them with his axe he killed the snake.  Title : Don't trust an evil man 10. Graph & charts When a person becomes a citizen of a country, s/he gains the right to do certain things. She/he has right to marry and have family according to his/her choice. S/he has right to have his/her own property. S/he has right to reside permanently and move about freely wherever s/he wants. As the nation of that country, s/he has the right to vote for his/her favourite person. S/he has right to take part in administrative works if s/he has qualification for it. S/he has right to lead his/her private and family life and exchange letters with someone freely. S/he also has the right to think freely. S/he has right for peaceful congregation and socialization. Like others s/he has equal rights to have government jobs if he/she is qualified for that jobs. So it can be said that if a citizen of a country has these rights to do, s/he is the real citizen and that country is the democratic country. First Paper  Solutions 11. Letter writing Faridpur November 10, 2015 Dear Rahim, I have just heard the news of your mother's death. The news has come to me as a bolt from the blue. It is a great loss for you. I don't have any language to console you in this situation. But you should remember that 'Man is mortal'. Today or tomorrow everybody must die. With the course of time, you and I also will say goodbye to the world. So, I request you to take this sad incident with courage . Remember, your SSC exam is near at hand. You must do well in it. You are the only son of your parents. If you lose heart, it will affect your exam performance and may ruin your career. So, take it easy for the sake of stern reality. In the end, I pray to Almighty Allah so that your mother's departed soul may rest in peace in heaven. I always pray for you so that you can cover up this irreparable loss. No more today. Your loving friend, Kamal

People cannot fish or swim in them.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : নীল আমর্স্ট্রং ছিলেন চন্দ্রপৃষ্ঠে হাটা প্রথম মানব। তিনি ছিলেন একজন আমেরিকান নভোচারী। তিনি একজন এরোস্পেস ইনজিনিয়ারও ছিলেন। যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের ওহাইওর অন্@গর্ত ওয়াপাকোনেটাতে ১৯৩০ সালের ৫ আগস্ট আমর্স্ট্রং জন্মগ্রহণ করেন। ১৯৪৫ সালে মাত্র ১৫ বছর বয়সে তিনি ফ্লাইট সাটিির্ফকেট অজর্ন করেন। ১৯৪৭ সালে ১৭ বছর বয়সে তিনি যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের পাদুর্ ইউনিভাসিির্টতে এরোনটিক্যাল ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং পড়তে শুরম্ন করেন। ১৯৫৫ সালে তিনি এরোনটিক্যাল ইঞ্জিনিয়ারিং-এ বি.এসসি. এবং ১৯৭০ সালে সাউথ ক্যালিফোনির্য়া ইউনিভাসিির্ট থেকে এরোস্পেস ইনজিনিয়ারিং-এ এম. এসসি. ডিগ্রি অজর্ন করেন। ১৯৫৮ সালে তিনি মহাশুন্য অভিযানে ইউএস বিমান সেনা কমর্সুচি-এর জন্য মনোনীত হন। ১৯৬৯ সালের জুলাই মাসে নীল আমর্স্ট্রং অ্যাপোলো- ১১ নিয়ে তাঁর দলসহ চন্দ্রাভিযানে যাত্রা করেন। তিনি ছিলেন অ্যাপোলো-১১-এর কমান্ডার এবং চারদিন পর তাঁরা চাঁদে অবতরণ করেন। তাঁরা দুই ঘণ্টার বেশি সময় ধরে চন্দ্রপৃষ্ঠ অনুসন্ধান এবং চন্দ্র শিলা সংগ্রহ করেন। পরদিন তাঁরা বিস্ফোরণ ঘটিয়ে চন্দ্রপৃষ্ঠ থেকে প্রত্যাবতর্ন করেন। 4. He is the main agent of our agriculture. A farmer is the pioneer of our agricultural (কৃষিজ) system. We cannot expect farming and production without the labour of our farmers. He grows and provides food for the people of our country. A farmer lives in a village. He leads a very simple life. He works from dawn (ভোর) to dusk. Rising in the morning, a farmer eats some 'panta bhat' or watered rice and goes to work in the field. If he has no food in the house, he goes without food. But he must work in the field in fair and foul weather. He tills the land and prepares the field for sowing seeds or transplanting (চারা লাগানো) seedlings. He earns so little that he cannot maintain his family well. He is often helped by his children. Though a farmer works very hard, he leads a hard life. He does not get fair price of his crops. He lives in a hut or cottage. A farmer lives in want. A landless farmer leads a very miserable life. Though a farmer is generally a very poor man, he is very soft-minded. He is very happy if there is a good harvest. But his sorrows know no bounds if there is a bad harvest (ফসল). As agriculture is the main source of our economy, we should do our best to improve the lot of our farmers. The government should take steps to educate them and help them with good seed, fertilizer and better agricultural knowledge. 9. Story writing Once upon a time there was a king named Midas. He was extremely fond of gold. Though he had a lot he thought if he had the golden touch he would be the happiest man. A wish god granted his wish promptly. Having the golden touch, he was very happy. Whatever he touched was turned to gold. He felt he was the happiest man in the world. He came back to the palace. Seeing him, his sweet little daughter came upto him. He touched her and she immediately turned to gold. The king loved his daughter more than anything else. He could not sustain her condition. He began to weep and felt repented to get his wish granted. Then the god took pity on him. He took away the power of golden touch.  Title : Greed brings about ruin and dstruction 10. Multiple Choice Questions (a) → (iii) polluting; (b) → (i) Living with moral qualities; (c) → (ii) It is the main source of the development of the heavenly qualities; (d) → (iv) heavenly; (e) → (iii) Moral degradation is a Made Easy to SSC English Test Papers sports and 25% with online programme. So from the graph it is seen that students of Bangladesh are becoming interested in watching TV and online programme. On the other hand their interest to games and sports are decreasing gradually. 2. Answering questions (a) Heavenly qualities of human beings mentioned in the passage are love, affections, heavenly feelings, respect and appreciation for others. (b) The sentence symbolises that various social crimes occur owing to human activities devoid of moral First Paper  Solutions sense. It also indicates that our society will be crime- free if all the activities of human beings are performed with the sense of morality. (c) Moral values ensure the establishment of social peace, order and justice. (d) Without the attachment of morality, all kinds of forces of evils will increase in every sector of society. According to the passage, severe moral degradation will be a crucial problem of mankind. (e) Yes, I support the attitude that seminars and symposia should be held on various occasions so that the people of all strata of life can be motivated and encouraged to accelerate moral uplift among them. And if it is successfully done, social peace, order and justice will be established automatically. 3. Summary Moral degradation is responsible for social degeneration. We should develop morality if we want to establish peace, order and justice. Morality is something that can help us make our society corruption-free. The lack of moral scruple encourages a man to commit crimes and social evils. So, it is the duty of all men to develop morality in themselves and do the needful for the uplift of mankind.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : কবি, সাহিত্যিক, সমাজকমীর্ ও নারীবাদী বেগম সুফিয়া কামাল বরিশালের শায়েস্@াবাদের এক জমিদার পরিবারে ১৯১১ সালের ২০ জুন জন্মগ্রহণ করেন। তিনি ছিলেন আইনজীবী আব্দুল বারি ও গৃহিণী সাবেরা বানুর কন্যা। সে সময়ে অভিজাত শ্রেণির সামাজিক প্রথা অনুযায়ী তিনি পরিবারেই শিÿা লাভ করেন। তিনি গৃহশিÿক থেকে উদুর্, আরবি ও ফাসির্ ভাষা শেখেন। এছাড়া তিনি তার মা এবং মামা সাইদ মোহাম্মদ হোসাইন থেকে বাংলা শিÿাও পেয়েছিলেন। ১৯১৮ সালে সুফিয়া তার মায়ের সাথে কলকাতা গমন করেন। এখানে তরম্নণী সুফিয়া, বেগম রোকেয়া সাখাওয়াত হোসেনের সাথে সাÿাৎ করেন। ১৯২৩ সালে সুফিয়া সবর্প্রথম 'সৈনিক বাহাদুর' নামে একটি গল্প লিখেন যেটি তরণ পত্রিকার থেকে প্রকাশিত হয়। ১৯৩৮ সালে তার প্রথম কবিতার বই 'সাঁঝের মায়া' প্রকাশিত হয়। কাজী নজরম্নল এর মুখবন্ধ লিখেছিলেন এবং রবীন্দ্রনাথ ঠাকুর বইটি পড়ে এর অনেক প্রশংসা করেছিলেন। সুফিয়া কামাল ১ ডজনের অধিক কাব্য, কয়েকটি ছোট গল্প এবং "একালে আমাদের কাল" নামে একটি আত্মজীবনী লিখেন। বাংলা একাডেমি পদক(১৯৬২), একুশে ও স্বাধীনতা পদক সুফিয়া কামাল বড় ধরনের প্রায় ৫০টি পুরস্কার পান। তিনি ১৯৯৯ সালের ২০ নভেম্বর ঢাকায় মৃত্যুবরণ করেন। 4. Paragraph writing My Dream Dream means a series of images, events and feelings that happen in our mind subconsciously while we are asleep. It is a psychological (মনস্@াত্ত্বিক) matter. Story writing Once there was a king who was very much fond of knowing his future from astrologers. A good astrologer happened to stop at his capital on his way to Benares. The king called him to know his future and the astrologer said something unpleasant. At this the king got furious and ordered his men to hang the palmist next day at a public place. The next day when the people had crowded round the palmist, he began to smile instead of weeping. The king got astonished seeing the smile of the palmist as if nothing serious had happened to him. He asked the old man, "You liar ! What makes you laugh at the time of end of your life ? Don't you fear death?" At this the old palmist laughed loudly and said that the king would die only a week later he died. Hearing these loud words of the cunning palmist, the king got very much afraid. For some time he could not say anything. Then he ordered his men to drive away the wretched (হতভাগ্য) palmist because he could not tolerate this man. Ordering this the king left the place quickly.  Title : A King and an Astrologer 10. Graphs & charts The mentioned graph shows weekly average hour worked by different professionals. This is a clear statistics of working hours of different professionals. 11. Answering questions (a) Social values mean a set of principles of norms and behaviors of a society which are widely acceptable among its people. (b) The impacts of social values in our forefathers life were that our forefathers were simple, honest, sincere, responsible, pious and sympathetic. (c) No, we are not better than our forefathers. On the other hand, we are worse than our forefathers. Our forefathers were simple, honest, pious, co-operative and what not. But most of us are corrupt and dishonest. (d) The present people follow the principles of dishonesty avoiding the social values of the past for their, conspiracy, faithlessness, envy, complicity and corruption. (e) We should follow the social values of the past to make a better society to live in. 3. Summary Social value is a set of principles which are widely acceptable among its people. In the past, the people were simple, honest, sincere, responsible, pious and sympathetic. But people are now self-centered and can do anything for their self-aggrandizement. The social values of the past are replaced by conspiracy, faithlessness, envy, dishonesty, complexity and corruption. Bribery and corruption are rampant in society. To save humanity, we should raise awareness among the people so that we can make a better world for living.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : বিজ্ঞানের বিভিন্ন ÿেত্রে অসাধারণ অবদান, সাহিত্য ও বিশ্বশান্@ি প্রতিষ্ঠার জন্য প্রতি বছর নোবেল পুরস্কার দেওয়া হয়। এই পুরস্কারের অধীনে পুরস্কার বিজয়ীরা পান একটি স্বণের্র মেডেল, একটি সনদ এবং একটা বড় অংকের টাকা। এই পুরস্কার যিনি প্রবতর্ন করেছিলেন তিনি ছিলেন ধ্বংসাত্বক বিজ্ঞানের আবিষ্কারক। এই বিজ্ঞানী হলেন আলফ্রেড বানার্ডর্ নোবেল। তিনি ১৮৩৩ সালের ২১ অক্টোবর স্টকহোমে জন্মগ্রহণ করেন এবং ১০ ডিসেম্বর ১৮৯৬ সালে মৃত্যুবরণ করেন। তিনি সুইডেনের নাগরিক হলেও রাশিয়ায় লেখাপড়া করেন। তিনি ডিনামাইট আবিষ্কার করেছিলেন। এই পদাথর্ ব্যাপকভাবে ব্যবহার হয় শিলাখণ্ড ভাঙতে, পেট্রোলের কূপ খনন করতে এবং যুদ্ধে। তাঁর মুল্যবান আবিষ্কারের কারণে নোবেল সারা বিশ্বে খ্যাতি লাভ করেন। তিনি এটা বিক্রি করে প্রচুর টাকা আয় করেন। ১৮৯৬ সালে তার মৃত্যুর সময় তিনি অবিশ্বাস্য ৯০,০০,০০০ ডলার রেখে যান তাদেরকে। তিনি একটি উইলে উলে-খ করে যান যে, তার এই টাকার সুদ থেকে তাদেরকে পুরস্কার দেওয়া হবে যারা পদাথির্বজ্ঞান, রসায়ন, চিকিৎসা, সাহিত্য এবং শান্@িতে অসাধারণ অবদান রাখবে। এই পুরস্কারের নামকরণ করা হয় নোবেল পুরস্কার। ১৯০১ সালের ১০ ডিসেম্বর রন্টজেনকে এক্সরে বিষয়ে তাঁর অসাধারণ গবেষণার জন্য প্রথম নোবেল পুরস্কার দেওয়া হয়। পুরস্কারটির অথর্মুল্য ছিল ৪০,০০০ ডলার। Made Easy to SSC English Test Papers 4. Paragraph writing A Book Fair A book fair is a special kind of fair where various kinds of books are put on display and sold. It gives an opportunity to buy and collect the valuable books at a cheap rate. Every year in the month of February, a large and gorgeous book fair is held to the premises of the Bangla Academy. This fair is called "Amar Ekushe Boi Mela". Actually, it is an annual function and Bangla Academy authorities arrange the fair in memory of the language martyrs. With a view to collecting some books on literature, (সাহিত্য) I went there. Whenever I entered the mela premises, I was really pleased at the calm and quiet environment. Though it was crowded with people, there was no chaotic situation there. There were many book-stalls containing a large number of books like fictions, plays, poetry, adventures, biographies, children's books, etc. I observed many of them and bought some fictions and biographies. Besides, many literary figures of our country flocked there. They added to the glamour of the fair. I took autographs from them. In the afternoon, a discussion meeting on the interesting topics of Bengali literature was held as usual. It highlighted the supreme (পরম) sacrifice of the martyrs of our Language Movement. This was followed by a cultural function to entertain the music lovers with sweet Bangla songs. The function was attended by many leading artists of the country. It acted as a soothing balm for many sorrow stricken hearts. I became spell-bound for the time being to listen to the melodious songs. I also became a bit nostalgic forgetting the hard realities of life. 9. Story writing  Title : Failures are but Pillars of Success See Mymensingh Girls' Cadet College. Sl. No. 01; Page No. 43 10. Letter writing 15 Station Road, Comilla February 12, 2016 My dear Sumon, I am very much glad to know what you had done during the last summer vacation for the common people of Bangladesh. Now I am telling you what I wish to do after my SSC exam. After the exam, I will go to my village home. You know that many people of our villages are illiterate. So I have made up my mind to start a course for adult literacy in my village. I will use the primary school house as the site of the course. I will ask the adult illiterate villagers to join the course. I hope, they will respond to my call positively and make the course a successful one. During this course, I will come in contact with the villagers, know their problems and have the first knowledge of social work. How do you like my plan? Let me know it by return of post.
