Paragraph writing An Ideal Student One who knows how to learn, read and write and above all, goes to an educational institute, is called a student. The student who prepares his lessons properly and regularly and avoids all those who stand in the way of studies is called an ideal student. An ideal student should be studious. This is his foremost (প্রধান) duty. An ideal student must be well-behaved (সদাচরণ). He must be truthful and honest. He is obedient to his superiors. He also avoids so called students politics and all kinds of bad habits. He should say his five times prayers in time. As he is a citizen of the country, he should love his country and must be ready to dedicate (উৎসগর্) his life for the welfare of his country. Answering questions (a) Following the historical records helps people for their original exposure. (b) If we look at the past, we realize that life was not easier than that of the present time. (c) We are indebted to the historians, philosophers, thinkers and so on. (d) The conflict of human being was a conflict between the good and the bad, between the good and evil. (e) We can learn from history that people used to change their attitude depending on their personal gains. 3. Summary History is important. In centuries past this statement would have seemed self-evident. Ancient cultures devoted much time and effort to teaching their children family history. It was thought that the past helps a child understand who he is. Modern society, however, has turned its back on the past. We live in a time of rapid change, a time of progress. We prefer to define ourselves in terms of where we are going, not where we come from. Our ancestors hold no importance for us. They lived in times so different from our 174 own that they are incapable of shedding light on our experience. Man is so much smarter now than he was even ten years ago that anything from the past is outdated and irrelevant to us. Therefore the past, even the relatively recent past, is, in the minds of most of us, enshrouded by mists and only very vaguely perceived. Our ignorance of the past is not the result of a lack of information, but of indifference. We do not believe that history matters.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Adarsha High School, Birampur, Dinajpur. Sl. No. 55; Page No. 105 4. Once day some friends of the rich man came to him to pay a visit . The rich man asked Bahadur to bring sweet mangoes for his friends. Bahadur went to the mango orchard and brought some ripe mangoes. He gave the mangoes to the friends of the rich man to eat. They started eating the mangoes but the mangoes tasted sour. Again Bahadur was asked to bring some sweet mangoes and as a result, he went to the orchard again and brought some mangoes. The guests began to eat and this time also, the mangoes tasted sour. (b) In 1948, Mohammad Ali Zinnah declared that Urdu world be the only official language of Pakistan. (d) The police opened fire when the procession reached near Dhaka Medical College. Summary 21st February is one the most remarkable day for Bangla history. On this day, we tribute to the martyrs who laid down their lives to establish Bangla as a stage language in undivided Pakistan in 1952. The recognition of February 21 as the International Mother Language Day by UNESCO surely will bring about the mutual understanding among the countries of the whole world. The sacrifices of all the martyrs for championing the cause of their mother tongue have received now a glorious recognition by the people of the world.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : মাউন্ট এভারেস্ট পৃথিবীর সবোর্চ্চ পবর্ত। এটির উচ্চতা সমুদ্র উপকূল হতে ২৯,০০০ ফুটের উপরে। জজর্ এভারেস্ট নামে একজন ইংরেজের নামে এর নামকরণ করা হয় যিনি ১৮৪১ সালে প্রথম হিমালয় পরিমাপ করেন। মাউন্ট এভারেস্ট জয় করার জন্য অনেক অভিযান পরিচালনা করা হয়। যার অনেকগুলো পরিত্যক্ত হয়। অনেক আরোহী আরোহণে অংশগ্রহণ করে তাদের জীবনও দিয়েছেন। নিউজিল্যান্ডের স্যার অ্যাডমান্ড হিলারি ও তার সঙ্গী নেপালের তানজিং নোরকে ১৯৫৩ সালে এক অভিযান পরিচালনা করেন। অভিযান যাত্রা শুরম্ন করেন ১০ মাচর্। তাদের অভিযান চলার কারণে তারা ভিন্ন ভিন্ন স্থানে ক্যাম্প স্থাপন করেন। ঐসব ক্যাম্পে তাঁরা তাঁদের কিছু লোক এবং মালপত্র রেখে যান। সবোর্চ্চ ক্যাম্প স্থাপন করা হয় ২৭০০ ফুট উঁচুতে। শুধু হিলারি ও তানজিং ২৫ মাচর্ সে উচ্চতায় পৌঁছান। কিন্তু সবোর্চ্চ চুড়া তখনও ২০০০ ফুট দুরে। তারা উপর হতে আরো উপরে উঠছে। দুই মাস কঠোর ও বিপজ্জনক আরোহণের পর তারা ১০ মে সফলভাবে

Summary Mime is one kind of theatrical medium or a performing art, involving miming, or the acting out a story through body motions, without use of speech. Miming is different from silent comedy. Marcel was the architect of a totally new style and tradition of a totally new style and tradition of mime. Partha is a harbinger in the field of mime in Bangladesh. guide_solution: 1. Multiple Choice Questions 181 (c) + (iv) Shaheed Minar is covered with flowers. (d) + (iii) The National flag is kept half-mast on this day. (e) + (ii) We offer flower at the foot of the Shaheed Minar. 2. Answering questions (a) Weather is a unit which is used to measure day to day variations in the atmosphere. (b) The variations are calculated by measuring daily temperature, the amount of precipitation, wind speeds variations and the humidity experienced in a particular region. (c) Climate is a long term look at weather friends such as monthly or yearly rainfall, or daily temperature measured over a period of time. (d) Now-a-days, the climate is measured by using complicated computer models which study all of the relevant variables and then produce a picture of the climate of an area. (e) The climatologists tend to use a period of weather records that stretch over a 30 year period. They use the weather records skillfully. 3. Summary Weather is a unit to measure daily variations in the atmosphere. Daily temperature, precipitation, wind speed and humidity are the key factors of variations. But climate is a long-term observation in weather conditions. Climate tends to be calculated by using computer models now by studying relevant variables and producing pictures. 182 Climatologists us a period of weather records to observe climate. Continental drift is a slower process. Weather conditions are varied according to the density of population because heat tends to be trapped in heavily populated areas and causes higher temperatures.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : পরিসংখ্যানে দেখা যায় যে, প্রায় ৩৫০ মিলিয়ন লোক প্রথম ভাষা হিসেবে ইংরেজিতে কথা বলে এবং আরো ৩০০ মিলিয়ন লোক এটাকে দ্বিতীয় ভাষা হিসেবে ব্যবহার করে। ৬০টিরও বেশি দেশে এবং অনেক আন্ত্মজাির্তক সংগঠনে এটা সরকারি বা আধা সরকারি ভাষা হিসেবে ব্যবহৃত হয়। উদাহরণস্বরূপ আন্ত্মজাির্তক অলিম্পিক কমিটি সবসময় ইংরেজিতে সভা করে। আন্ত্মজাির্তক সম্প্রদায় এবং ব্যবসায়ী বিশ্বকে জাতীয় সীমানা অতিক্রম করে যোগাযোগ করতে ইংরেজি সাহায্য করে। অধুনা বিশ্বের কম্পিউটারের তথ্যের শতকরা ৮০ ভাগেরও বেশি ইংরেজি ভাষাতেই সম্পাদিত হয়, তাই প্রতিষ্ঠানগুলোতে সচরাচর এমন সব কমর্চারী নিয়োগ করা হয় যারা একটা মানসম্মত পযাের্য়র ইংরেজি বলতে ও লিখতে পারে। বস্ত্মুত কিছু প্রতিষ্ঠান তাদের কমীের্দর ইংরেজি প্রশিÿণ দিয়ে থাকে। তাই আজকাল এটা কোনো বিস্ময়ের ব্যাপার নয় যে, চাকরির বিজ্ঞাপনে প্রায়শই ইংরেজিতে ভাল কমর্দÿতা চাওয়া হয়। এখন অনেকেই বিশ্বাস করে যে ইংরেজি তাদের সাধারণত ভাল চাকরি ও বেতন পেতে সাহায্য করে। 4. guide_solution: 1. Multiple Choice Questions (a) → (iv) conflict; (b) → (ii) wisdom, tectfulness and tolerant understanding on the part of the parents; (c) → (ii) 183 Last week I enjoyed the marriage ceremony of my elder sister. The marriage was solemnized at our local community centre. A nicely decorated gate was made. The whole centre was decorated nicely with colourful lights, poster and balloons. More than two hundred guests were invited there. The guests started coming after sunset sharp. I put an my new fashionable dress. My friends appreciated me much in my dress. I along with my father and friends stood at the gate to welcome the guests. The guests of bridegroom also came in time. At a point the community centre turned into a gettogether centre. All of the guests exchanged their greetings with others. My parents were so much busy with the guests. I was also busy with my friends. The guests took their seats accordingly and had delicious foods such as pollao, birani, white rich with beef, mutton, chicken and so on, The most attraction was the sweet batel leaves. The guests had brought a lot of valuable gifts for the bride and bride-groom. My dear ones and relatives also helped my parents arranging the marriage ceremony. I had made much fun of the bride-groom. At the end of the ceremony all the guests left the place thanking my parents and appreciated them for a nice arrangement. May parents also thanked them for attending the ceremony. I enjoyed the wedding ceremony most.  Title : A memorable day in my life. 2. Answering questions (a) Parents can avoid friction with their teenaged daughters or sons being wise, tactful, tolerant in dealing with them. (b) The most conspicuous cause of friction between these two groups in the transition from dependence to independence and the more the presents try to control, the more rebellous they become. (c) The behaviour on the adolescents are moody, sulky, quarrelsome and obstinate. (d) The adolescents rebel against the ways and thoughts of the older generation. 184 (e) Sometimes a boy or a girl wants to leave school but parents force him or her to stay on. In this way, it creats conflict. 3. Summary Friction between teenagers and parents is very much common. It does not occur in all homes and it can be avaoded if the parents are wise, cordial, co-operative, compromising, tolerant and understanding in their dealings with teenaged boys and girls. Moody, sulky quarrelsome and obstinate behaviours are common characteristics that lead to friction between the teen-aged children and their parents. We should all keep aloof from friction.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Govt. S.C. Girls' High School, Sunamganj. Sl. No. 110; Page No. 155 4. Graph & charts The graph shows the elderly people's changing attitude to pastimes in a community. Here we see that in 1990, 32% of elderly people spent time watching TV which was 41% in 2000 and 49% in 2010. In case of playing cards the percentage was 34% in 1990, 36% in 2000 and 39% in 2010. Moreover, in 1990, people spent 17% of their time in other activities 11% in 2000 and 7% in 2010. Thus we see that the attitude to pastimes of the elderly people is changing. guide_solution: 1. Multiple Choice Questions (a) → (i) resists (b) → (iii) social ideas about good and bad (c) → (iv) think about his personal profit only (d) → (ii) working for the betterment of the society (e) → (i) + (iii) (f) → (i) The knowledge about the fundamental things of the country (g) → (iii) To show how a person can be a good citizen. 2. Answering questions (a) One can achieve the skills and attitude of a good citizen by acquring practical skills of a citizen. And he may attain these skills by knowing and following some fundamental things of the country. (b) Only knowledge about the fundamental things of the state is not enough to obtain the skills and attitude of a good citizen. One can attain them by practising them practically. (c) If a citizen wants to be a good citizen he has to acquire some good qualities. The three major qualities of them are − knowing the fundamental things of the country, acquring the skills and attitude of a good citizen and being loyal to the laws of the country. (d) A good citizen is respectful to other citizens. He shows respect to others' rights. 188 (e) A good citized is loyal to his state. He always thinks for the betterment of the state. He works for the greater welfare and interest of the country. 3. Summary The text is about the qualities of a good citizen. One has to acquire some qualities to be a good citizen. Firstly he must know some fundamental things about his state. Then he will follow them. He must be respectful to the rights of other citizens. He will abide by the laws of the country. He always think for the betterment of his country. He must not think about his own interest even he will be ready to die for his country. Thus he can be a good citizen.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : হেনরি ওয়াডর্সওয়াথর্ লংফেলো ১৮০৭ খ্রিস্টাব্দে পোটর্ল্যান্ডের ম্যাইনে জন্মগ্রহণ করেন এবং ইয়কর্সায়ার স্টকে আসেন। তিনি তের বছর বয়সে কাব্য প্রকাশ করতে শুরম্ন করেন। বোডন কলেজে পড়াশুনার পর তিনি দুরদেশে ভ্রমণ করেন এবং তাঁর নিজ কলেজে আধুনিক ভাষার অধ্যাপকের কাজের জন্য নিজেকে প্রস্তুত করেন। তিনি ১৮২৯ খ্রিস্টাব্দে ঐ পদটি গ্রহণ করেন। ১৮৩৬ খ্রিস্টাব্দে হাভাের্ডর্ তিনি ঐরূপ একটি পদে নিযুক্ত হন এবং আরো ভ্রমণ করেন। তিনি ১৮৫৪ খ্রিস্টাব্দে তাঁর অধ্যাপনায় ইস্@ফা দিয়ে সম্পুণর্ভাবে কবিতার মধ্যে আত্মনিয়োগ করেন, যা ইতপুবের্ই অনেকগুলোতে পরিণত হয়েছিল। তাঁর প্রসিদ্ধ রচনাবলি হলো"The Pilgrimage Beyond the Sea (1834-1835), Voices of The Night (1839), Evangeline (1847), The Song of Hiawatha (1855), The Counter ship of Miles Standish (1858), The Tales of Wayside (1863)। এইস, ডবি-উ লংফেলো ছিলেন একজন সতকর্ কবি এবং নানাবিধ বিষয়ের উপর তিনি রচনা করেন। তাঁর গীতিকবিতা বহুসংখ্যক, সুশ্রাব্য এবং আবেগপ্রবণ। তিনি ১৮৮২ খ্রিস্টাব্দে মৃত্যুবরণ করেন। 4. Information transfer (i) Bowdoin college; (ii) 1836; (iii) Resigned professor- ship; (iv) published 'Voice of the Night'; (v) 1882 5. Filling in gaps without clues (a) thirteen (b) abroad (c) job (d) resigned (e) devoted 6. Matching (a) + (ii) We must acknowledge our debt to the parents and then to nature. (b) + (iv) The first lesson we learned was from our parents. (c) + (vi) They taught us how to eat, how to talk and how to live (d) + (i) But when we came out of our house, we discovered the endless mystery of nature. (e) + (iii) We wondered how graceful the creator is to arrange everything in order. 7. Reordering sentences (b) + (f) + (g) + (d) + (a) + (c) + e + h Section B : Writing Test 8. Paragraph writing A Historical Place I Have Visited A historical place is a place which bears testimony to our culture and history. We have a fascination for such places. It has an educative and cultural value. It was December, 2013. We started to visit the historical place of Mohastangar in Bogra. The relics of the museum charmed (আকৃষ্ট করেছিল) us. We wandered in the vast ground of the museum. We mounted the top (চূড়া). We enjoyed the natural beauties of the surroundings (চারিপাশ্বের্র). We then visited the Mohammad Ali Park. We tasted the renowned curd of Bogra. The area is famous for curd. It seemed to me very tasty. While returning, we had some pots of curd. In fact, we became attracted by it. We could spend our leisure with profound enjoyment. We returned Dhaka safely. I think this visit really widened (প্রসারিত করেছিল)my outlook. When I remember the visit, I feel I should visit other historical places of our country because they represent our magnificent culture, tradition (ঐতিহ্য) and heritage. Made Easy to SSC English Test Papers 9. Story writing There was a farmer in Africa named Hamid. He had a small farm where he worked happily. He was happy and content because he had no high ambition. One day a wise man came to him and told him about the glory of diamonds and the power that goes along with them. The wise man said, "If you had a diamond the size of your thumb, you could buy your own city. If you had a diamond the size of your fist, you could probably buy your own country". And then the wise man left. That night, Hamid couldn't sleep. He was unhappy and discontented. However, he returned home. Then he noticed that the person who had bought his farm was watering the camels at the stream that ran through the property. Across the stream, the rays of the morning sun hit a stone and made it sparkle like a rainbow. He thought that the stone would look good in his living room. He picked up the stone and put it on his mantle piece. That afternoon, the wise man came and saw the stone sparkling. He asked, "Is Hamid back?" The new owner said, "No, why do you ask?" The wise man said, "Because that is a diamond. I recognize one when I see one." The man said, "No that's just a stone I picked up from the stream. Come I'll show you. There are many more." They went and picked some samples and sent them for analysis. Sure enough, the stones were diamonds. They found that the farm was indeed covered with acres of diamonds.  Title : Acres of Diamonds 10. Graph & chart A graph on selling books in Ekushey Boi Mela. See Rangpur Cadet College. Sl. No. 06; Page No. 50 11. Letter writing A letter to my brother advising him not mix with evil/bad companions. See Police Lines School & College, Rangpur. Sl. No. 52; Page No. 103 12. Dialogue writing A dialogue between two friends about bad effect of corruption. Myself : How are you, Nila? Nila : I'm fine, thanks. Myself : Nila, do you know what corruption is? Nila : Actually, I don't have any clear idea about it. Myself : I know. Nila : I don't read newspapers and watch TV news. So, I'm ignorant about this. Myself : Corruption is the use of public sources for personal gains. It is a curse for any nation. Nila : I mean, corruption means malpractice, irregularities? Myself : Right, corruption has turned into a social cancer. It is like termite nibbling at the fabric of society. Nila : What about our country? Is corruption practised here? Myself : You'd be surprised to know that Bangladesh is the most corrupted country in the world. Nila : It's really a shame. It means that corruption of all types is practised here. Myself : Right, all types of irregularities and evil practices are done in the country unhindered. Nila : What is the government doing to curb the hydra-headed monster of graft? Myself : The government has already taken few bold steps to prevent corruption. Nila : It's really a bad news for our country. First Paper  Solutions Myself : Obviously, so raise awareness of the bad impacts of corruption.

Answering questions (a) Patriotic jeal makes a man dutiful. A man having true patriotism becomes loyal to rules and regulations and he does his duties properly. (b) The teaching of patriotism is to grow the sense of fellow feeling, fraternity love and sympathy for the countrymen. It teaches a man to give up self-interest and even to sacrifice his life at the altar of the motherland. (c) A patriot deserves utmost respect because he is not self-centered. As he works for the betterment of his country and his countrymen, he deserves honour in return. (d) A traitor sinks into oblivion as he is not remembered after his death. Despite having wealth, power and knowledge, he is unsung, he is forgotten. (e) An unpatriotic person dies a double death. Firstly, he dies possessing a dead soul and being forgotten. Secondly, he dies physically. 3. Summary The text is about partiotism. Patriotism, we know, is a noble virtue that inspires a man to give self-interest and to do everything for the betterment of his country. Even a patriot his ready to sacrifice his our for his country. So he deserves profound honour. On the other hand, an unpatriotic person is dishonoured by everybody. Inspite of his having money, power and knowledge, he is very ignoble. He dies twice. In his life time he dies by possessing a dead soul. After his physical death no one mourns for him.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Pabna Cadet College . Sl. No. 04; Page No. 47 4. guide_solution: 1. Multiple Choice Questions (a) →(iii) make up; (b) → (iii) hand in hand; (c) → (ii) Impossible; (d) →(iii) womenfolk; (e) → (iv) noble; (f) → (i) Women have duties to perform as men do; (g) → (i) The role of women should never be ignored in building up the nation. 2. Answering questions (a) Women can play an important role in nation building if they get opportunity. First Paper  Solutions (b) They perform their traditional role as a mother, wife and home maker. Besides they are also performing well in national activities. (c) Almost half of the population of the world and of our country is women. (d) The role of women in the formation of nation cannot be denied. (e) Women have noble missions to perform as those of men. 3. Summary The passage discusses the role of women in the present world. The concept of women’s role has changed over time. Nowadays we see the women have come out of their kitchens and are working hand in hand with their male partners. They have great responsibility of building the nations. They perform their traditional role as a mother, wife and home maker. Besides they are also performing well in national activities. There is a proverb with the women folk that the hand that rocks the cradle rules the world. So the role of women cannot be ignored any more.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : আবুল কাশেম ফজলুল হক বরিশালের সাটুরিয়ায় ১৮৭২ সালে জন্মগ্রহণ করেন। তিনি সেখানে একটি গ্রামীণ মক্তবে প্রাথমিক শিÿা গ্রহণ করেন। তিনি বরিশাল জেলা স্কুলে ভতির্ হন। তিনি ঢাকা বিভাগে প্রথম স্থান অধিকার করে প্রবেশিকা পরীÿায় পাস করেন। তারপর উচ্চ শিÿার জন্য তিনি কলকাতায় গমন করেন। একুশ বছর বয়সে তিনি কলকাতা প্রেসিডেন্সি কলেজ থেকে রসায়ন, পদাথর্ ও গণিতে সম্মানসহ বিএসসি পরীÿায় পাস করেন। তিনি ১৮৯৫ সালে গণিতে এমএসসি ডিগ্রি লাভ করেন। পরের বছর তাঁকে কলকাতা বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়ে এমএ ক্লাসে গণিতের পরীÿক হিসেবে নিয়োগ দেওয়া হয়। ১৮৯৭ সালে তিনি ডিস্টিংশনের সাথে বিএল(ব্যাচেলর অব ল) পরীÿায় পাস করেন এবং কলকাতা উচ্চ আদালতে স্যার আসুতোষ মুখাজির্র সহকারী হিসেবে নিজের নাম লেখান। তিনি নবাব স্যার সলিমুল-াহ বাহাদুরের সাথে কাজ করেন এবং ১৯০৬ সালে নিখিল ভারত মুসলিম লীগ গঠনে গুরম্নত্বপুণর্ ভূমিকা পালন করে থাকেন। একই বছর তিনি তাঁর আইন পেশাকে বাদ দেন এবং ডেপুটি ম্যাজিস্ট্রেট হন। তিনি কিছু সময়ের জন্য কাজ করার পর ইস্@ফা দেন এবং ১৯১২ সালে পুনরায় কলকাতা উচ্চ আদালতে যোগদান করেন। ১৯১৩ সালে প্রথমবারের মতো তিনি এম. এল. সি.(মেম্বার অভ লেজিসলেটিভ কাউন্সিল) নিবাির্চত হন। তিন বছর পরে তিনি কংগ্রেস ও লখনৌর মুসলিম লীগের বিশেষ যৌথ অধিবেশনে যোগদান করেন এবং বিশেষ ভূমিকা পালন করেন। ১৯১৮ সালে তিনি ইণ্ডিয়ান ন্যাশনাল কংগ্রেস-এর সাধারণ সম্পাদক ও নিখিল ভারত মুসলিম লীগের সভাপতি হন। 4. guide_solution: 1. Multiple Choice Questions (a) → (i) Barisal; (b) → (i) Kazi Wazed; (c) → (ii) strong and stout; (d) → (ii) tearing off; (e) → (ii) sharp memory; (f) → (ii) a great man; (g) → (iii) extraordinary talent. 2. Answering questions (a) Fazlul Haque is called sher-e-Bangla became he fought for the cause of his country as a tiger. (b) To test his merit his father asked him to quote somethings from different pages of his book. (c) He tore off the pages because he had already memorised them. (d) His father's idea was that he would be a great man in the subcontinent one day. (e) His teachers loved him for his extra-ordinary talent. 3. Summary 192 AK Fazlul Haque was a great leader of our country. He fought for the cause of his country like a tiger. That's why people called him sher-e-Bangla. He was very talent. He could memorize his lessons by reading once. His father was very much pleased with him. He thought his son would be a great man in the sub-continent in future. His teachers also loved him very much for his extra-ordinary talent.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : আমেরিকান নভোচর নীল আমের্স্ট্রাং ছিলেন প্রথম ব্যক্তি যিনি চাঁদে হেটে ছিলেন। ইহা ছিল বিংশশতাব্দীর সবচেয়ে স্মরণীয় বিষয়গুলোর একটি, ইহাই ছিল চাঁদের তার প্রথম বিচরণ "মানুষের জন্য একটি ছোট পদÿেপ, মানবকল্যাণের জন্য একটি বড় পদÿেপ।" ১৯৩০ সালের ৫ই আগষ্ট নীল অলভেন আমের্স্ট্রাং ওহিত্তর ওয়াপ কোনেতায় জন্ম গ্রহণ করেন। তিনি সন্@ান সিটফেন, ভাইওলা ও অ্যাঞ্জেল আমের্স্ট্রাং-এর মধ্যে ছিলেন বড়। ছয় বছর বয়স থেকেই উড়োজাহাজ তাকে আকৃষ্ট করতে থাকে যখন তিনি প্রথম উড়োজাহাজে চড়েন। ১৪ বছর বয়স থেকেই তিনি উড়োজাহাজ বিদ্যা শুরম্ন করেন এবং ১৬ বছর বয়সে তিনি বৈমানিক হিসেবে একটি লাইসেন্স পান। এমনকি সেই সময়ে একজন মারাত্মক বৈÿনিক আমের্স্ট্রাং তার নিজ বাড়ীর নীচ তলায় একটি বাতাসে শুড়ঙ্গ তৈরি করেন। তার নিমির্ত পরিÿিত উড়োজাহাজ দিয়ে তিনি অভিজ্ঞতা সম্পন্ন করেন। যদিও এই সব কমর্কাণ্ড যা তিনি শুরম্ন করে ছিলেন তা বিমান চলাচল বিদ্যায়, বা নকশায়, নিমাণর্ এবং বিমান চলাচল বিদ্যায় বৈষম্য আনে। আমের্স্ট্রাং বাল্যকালেই মহাশু ন্য নিয়ে আগ্রহী ছিলেন। তার প্রতিবেশীর দ্বারা তার আকাষর্ণ উৎসাহিত এই যন্ত্রের মাধ্যমে তিনি তারা, চাঁদ, গ্রহপুঞ্জ দেখেছিলেন। 4. Information transfer (i) walk on the moon; (ii) Wapakoneta, Ohio; (iii) 1930; (iv) Outer space; (v) at young age. 5. Filling in gaps without clues (a) eldest; (b) drew; (c) flying; (d) built; (e) performed. 6. Matching (a) + (v) We can collect rain water in ordered to drink as safe water. (b) + (iii) Though rain water is arsenic free you can't drink it. (c) + (ii) You can't remove arsenic by boiling it. (d) + (i) Unless you fitter the water from a red tube-well it should be collected in proper way. (e) + (iv) One can prevent arsenicosis by drinking arsenic free water. 7. Reordering sentences (c) + (e) + (g) + (h) + (f) + (a) + (b) + (d) Section B : Writing Test 8. Paragraph writing A Bus station Commonly a bus station is a place where buses stop and start from. It is a sort of temporary shelter for the passengers. Generally, it stands at the outskirts of a town or a city. It carries a great value for the passengers of long drive. Passengers have to wait for some time to catch a bus. So they come and wait for buses in a stand in a waiting room. In some bus stations there are many counters for tickets; people stand in a queue for buying tickets. Sometimes, there is an exchange of hot words if anybody breaks the line. Sometimes, there is a book-stall or arrangement for light refreshment there. Hawkers with snacks, betel-leaf and cigarette make a little business in a bus stand. Sometimes, seasonal fruits are sold in a bus station. People have to wait for a long time to avail themselves of a bus as there are not enough buses to carry the passengers. Most of the buses cannot come to the station in time because of traffic jam. It is sometimes seen that buses are overcrowded and the environment inside the buses is suffocating. There rises a hue and cry. Pushing and shoving occur among the passengers. It looks like a mini battle field. However, nowadays, there are some bus stands where some rules and regulations are maintained. Though it Made Easy to SSC English Test Papers is a crowded place for a secured and comfortable journey, the service facilities of each bus station should be improved. 9. Story writing  Title : The Cleverness of a Crow See Comilla Cadet College. Sl. No. 08; Page No.53 10. Graph & charts Here in the graph, the total number of candidates in SSC Examination-2013 has been shown in three groups namely. Science, Humanities and Business Studies. In all groups, male candidates are shown through deep pink coloured columns and female ones are shown through light pink coloured ones. In case of Science, we see male students are 41,812 while female ones are 29,660. So, the boys outnumber the girls by 12, 152. In Humanities, boys are 32,776 and girls are 62,630. Then girls have outnumbered the boys by almost two times. In Business Studies, male candidates are shown to be 83,547 and female ones 66.941. So, the males outnumber the females by 16,606. In conclusion, we can say in Science and Business studies the males surpass. considerably, but in Humanities, females far outnumber the males. In this graph, the choices of studies vary to a great extent. It is natural that the female students are more fond of studying Humanities group the other two ones. The male students are, on the other hand, more fond, of Science and Business Studies groups than Humanities group. 11. Letter writing 1/1, Banglabazar, Dhaka 20 June, 2015 My dear 'X' I received your letter yesterday and became very happy to know that you are all well. Today I am giving you a very exciting news. You will be happy to know that the marriage ceremony of my elder brother/younger sister has been finalized. It will be solemnized (প্রচলিত আচার অনুযায়ী বিয়ের অনুষ্ঠান সম্সস্নাদন করা) on 25 June in Dhaka. A community centre has already been booked for this purpose. I am very busy now. Some of my friends Ovi, Ananda, Amio, Shujan are here to give me a helping hand in arranging the function. You are cordially invited. I shall be very happy if you come at least one day before the ceremony. So please do come direct to our house. Your company will make the ceremony more enjoyable (উপভোগ্য). That's all for the day. My best regards to uncle and aunt. Please phone me when you are coming. Hope for the best. Take care. Yours lovingly Y 12. Dialogue writing A dialogue between myself and my friend Nadib about an interesting and exciting cricket match between Bangladesh and Pakistan. Myself : Hello Abed! How did you enjoy the final match of the Twenty-20 World Cup Cricket? Nadib : Oh! It was really very exciting. I really enjoyed it. My favourite team became the champion. Myself : I was greatly disheartened (হতাশ). I really can't accept the defeat of my favourite cricket team in the final match. Nadib : Don't you think, the better team gets the final trophy? First Paper  Solutions Myself : I think, Pakistan Cricket Team is no less good than India. Nadib : But you must admit that on the day, India definitely out played Pakistan. Myself : That's true, Pakistan batting order crumbled (ভেঙ্গে পড়া) unfortunately and brought this defeat.

guide_solution: 1. Multiple Choice Questions (a) → (iv) vertically; (b) → (ii) blood; (c) → (iii) martyrs of the Liberation War; (d) → (iv) threat; (e) → (ii) 1972; (f) → (i) People's respect to the martyrs; (g) → (iv) The sight is very touching. 2. Answering questions (a) The National Memorial symbolizes the supreme sacrifice of the martyrs of the War of Liberation. (b) The relics of the Liberation War will be preserved in the museum so that the people who will come to visit it can see the relics. (c) 'Man is born to be free' means no man wants to be in bondage since his birth. (d) The museum is built near the monument for keeping the relics of the Liberation War in the museum. (e) The several graves of the martyred freedom fighters are the most touching scene of the memorial complex. 3. Summary The National Memorial at Savar was built in memory of the martyred freedom fighters. They sacrificed their lives to free the country from the oppression of the Pakistani rulers. The foundation of the memorial was laid on the first anniversary of the Victory Day. It is built on an area of 126 acres. There will be a mosque, a library and a museum to keep the relics of the Liberation War in the complex of the memorial.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : বিংশ শতাব্দীর শ্রেষ্ঠ বিজ্ঞানী ও সবর্কালের শ্রেষ্ঠ জ্ঞানীদের অন্যতম, আলবাটর্ আইনস্টাইন, ১৮৭৯ সালের ১৪ই মাচর্ জামাির্নর উলম শহরে জন্মগ্রহণ করেন। তিনি সুইজারল্যান্ডের এক উচ্চ বিদ্যালয়ে শিÿা গ্রহণ করেন এবং ১৯০১ সালে সুইজারল্যান্ডের নাগরিক হন। ১৯০২ সালে তিনি সুইজারল্যান্ডের পণ্য পরীÿণ অফিসের একজন পরীÿক নিযুক্ত হন। তিনি এই পদে তিন বছর চাকরি করেন। ১৯০৫ সালে তিনি যুরিখ বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় থেকে পিএইচডি ডিগ্রি লাভ করেন কিন্তু ঐ সময়ে কোনো শিÿকতার পদ লাভে ব্যথর্ হন। যাহোক, সে বছরই তিনি তত্ত্বীয় পদাথির্বজ্ঞানের বিভিন্ন জটিল সমস্যার ওপর মৌলিক গবেষণা নিবন্ধ প্রকাশ করতে থাকেন। কয়েক বছরের মধ্যেই তাঁর এসব প্রকাশিত নিবন্ধ বিশেষ করে আপেÿিকতা তত্ত্বটি একজন মৌলিক চিন্@াশীল মেধাবী পদাথির্বজ্ঞানী হিসেবে পৃথিবীব্যাপী তার সুনাম ছড়িয়ে দেয়। তাঁর তত্ত্বগুলো যথেষ্ট বিতকির্ত হওয়া সত্ত্বেও বালির্ন বিশ্ববিদ্যালয় তাঁকে অধ্যাপক পদে নিয়োগ দেয়, একই সময়ে তিনি প্রম্নসিয়ার বিজ্ঞান একাডেমির সদস্যও নিযুক্ত হন। ১৯২১ সালে তাঁকে পদাথির্বজ্ঞানে নোবেল পুরস্কার প্রদান করা হয়। হিটলার যখন ÿমতায় আসেন তখন আইনস্টাইনের জামাির্নতে অবস্থান খুবই গুরম্নত্বপুণর্ হয়ে ওঠে। তিনি ১৯৩৩ সালে প্রাগ্রসর গবেষণা প্রতিষ্ঠানে কাজ করার জন্য যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের নিউ জাসির্র প্রিন্সটান চলে যান এবং ১৯৪০ সালে যুক্তরাষ্ট্রের নাগরিকত্ব লাভ করেন। আইনস্টাইনের প্রথম বিবাহ বিচ্ছেদের মাধ্যমে সমাপ্ত হয় কিন্তু তার দ্বিতীয় বিয়ে অনেকটা সুখের হয়। তার দুটি সন্@ান ছিল, উভয়ই ছেলে। তিনি ১৯৫৫ সালে প্রিন্সটনে মারা যান। 4. guide_solution: 1. Multiple Choice Questions (a) → (ii) first day; (b) → (i) wears; (c) → (ii) appetizing; (d) → (iii) new; (e) → (ii) reflects; (f) → (ii) conventional; (g) → (ii) enjoy. 2. Answering questions (a) Pahela Boishakh is the first day of Bangla year. (b) Halkahata means to give up or close the old debit credit account and open the fresh account book. On the day of Halkhata the businessmen offer sweets to their customers to make the event more charming. (c) On this day, the housewives wear new dresses and prepare different types of appetizing dishes like 'Panta-vat' and 'Panta-payesh'. (d) The socio-cultural organizations arrange cultural and other programmes including patriotic songs, traditional dances, discussion, poetry recitation etc. (e) On this day, the village people mostly take the day off from their work and enjoy the day with relatives and family members. They take their children to fairs and bazars and buy them different toys, dolls, dresses, sweetmeats and flutes. 3. Summary Pahela Boishakh is the first day of Bangla year. Every year this day is celebrated following Bengali culture and customs. Housewives prepare different appetizing foods and wear new dresses. The businessmen open halkhata and the cultural organizations organize different cultural programmes. The village people mostly keep away from their work and enjoy the day with near and dear ones. They bring their children to the nearest fairs and bazars and buy them different playing things. However, this day is observed with great enthusiasm and excitement across the country.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : See Shahpur Secondary School, Dumuria, Khulna. Sl. No. 74; Page No. 122

Answering questions (a) The term 'communicative English' means a system in which the English language is taught through communication between the teachers and the students in English in lively environment paving the way for learning the language in an effective manner. (b) For implementing the communicative English in the classroom, the classroom should be equipped with all kinds of modern amenities. In this respect, we have some limitations and these limitations create a problem in implementing the communicative English in the classroom. (c) In this method, both the teachers and students are supposed to communicate with each other in English in the classroom. As a result, the students are able to remove their shyness and uneasiness to speak English and at the same time, the teachers can enrich themselves. Consequently, the teachers and the learners are benefited by this method. (d) In this process, both the teachers and the learners are provided with an opportunity to take part in the classroom activities. They communicate with each other in English paving the way for the students to have a command over English. This is why, it is an effective process of learning English. (e) The purpose of introducing communicative English for the learners is to help them to have a communicative competence in English. 3. Summary In the field of teaching, the Bangladesh government has introduced communicative English at the secondary and the higher secondary levels, which is a time demanding initiative. This method helps the students a lot to have accuracy in English. In this system, both the teachers and the students take part in the classroom activities. They communicate with each other in the classroom in English as a result of which the students can remove their shyness and uneasiness while the teachers can enrich themselves. The main objective of communicative English is to help the students in acquiring communicative competence in English. This method also helps the learners to develop the four skills of the language. In order to implement the system practically the classroom should be equipped with all kinds of modern facilities. The government has already furnished many schools with multimedia facilities. We have a population of about 130 million people. Every year our country is frequently (প্রায়ই) visited by national calamities (দুযোর্গসমূহ). While this is true, we have Made Easy to SSC English Test Papers some glaring (চোখ ধাঁধানো) features on which we can pride ourselves. Our people are simple and brave and are capable of facing any calamity. They are quite hospitable (অতিথিপরায়ণ). As a Muslim country, most of the people of our country are religious. Our Bangladesh is a country of villages. It is criss-crossed by many rivers. They help our agriculture mostly. The forest areas in the Sundarbans and the largest sea-beach at the Bay of Bengal are the handiwork (হাতের কাজ) of Nature's beauty. We have six seasons and each season comes with its own taste and beauty. The golden fields of crops, green trees, tea gardens, murmuring streams (জলপ্রবাহ), large meadows (তৃণভূমি), the hills, the flowers with their dazzling (চোখ-ধাঁধানো) colours, the birds with their sweet songs have made this land a place of marvels. I would request you to come to our country once and visit the tourist resorts (আশ্রয়). I will escort (সঙ্গে গমন করা) you to the places of historical interest and importance. So much for the present. With all the best wishes. Yours ever, Nibir 12. Dialogue writing A dialogue on the impact of unfair means in the exam hall. See Rajshahi Cadet College. Sl. No. 03; Page No. 47

guide_solution: Seen Comprehension-01 Long ago, a young man found life in the family in his village full of problems and sufferings. Quarrels, ill-feelings, jealously, enmity - all were parts of everyday life there. So he left his house and went to a jungle to live by himself. There he made a nice little hut with wood, bamboo and reeds. “Ah, how happy I am here!” said the man to himself. But one day he found some mice in his hut. The little creatures soon made holes in his blanket. So he brought a cat to kill the mice. The cat needed milk. So he brought a cow. The cow needed grass and hay. So he brought a cowboy. The cowboy needed food. So he took a wife to cook meals. Then children were born to them, and the man found himself again in a family. So nobody can live alone, unless they are either angels or devils. People need food, shelter, companions and cooperation. They need to help each other. And if they live in a family or community, their need can be fulfilled. Hence living in society can make people good and happy citizens. 1. Choose the correct answer from the following alternatives. 1 x 7 = 7 (a) What does the expression 'He found all these unbearable' mean in sentence 5? i. He found the rats unbearable ii. He found cow and cowboy unbearable iii. He found quarrels, ill-feelings, jealousy, etc unbearable iv. He found the atmosphere of the jungle unbearable (b) Which of the following words describes 'men's ill-feeling' best? i. friendship ii. love iii. enmity iv. benevolence (c) Why does a man need to live in a family? Because he_____. i. loves family life ii. needs assistance from others iii. loves jungle life iv. finds peace in lonely life (d) "It, is only possible if a person is either an angel or a devil." The sentence is talking about_____. i. living alone ii. living with animals iii. having wife iv. going to a jungle (e) Where did the young man go to live alone? i. Ina town ii. Ina village iii. Ina hill iv. In the woods (f) The young man was beset with _____ in his village. i. peace and prosperity ii. problems and peace iv. popularity iii. problems and sufferings (g) The but in the jungle was made with______. i. bamboo, reeds and iron rod ii. brick, reeds and bamboo iii. wood, bamboo and brick iv. wood, bamboo and reeds Additional Questions (h) The little creatures soon made holes in his blanket. What were the 'little creatures' here? i. cows ii. mite iii. dogs iv. snakes (i) A cow was brought to______ the cat. i. kill ii. feed iii. guard iv. take care of (j) What does the word 'suffering' mean in the initial line? i. surprises ii. dangers iii. difficulties iv. charms (k) The word 'jealousy' means_______. i. jewalery ii. envy iii. fraternity iv. glory (l) The story shows that man cannot live_______. i. in the society ii. alone iii. in the family iv. at the village (m) Why did the young man need a cowboy? i. To kill the mice ii. To make a but iii. To take care of the cow iv. To take care of the cat (n) The young man went to jungle to_______. i. find peace ii. hunt animals iii. make a but iv. enjoy nature (o) The children were born to them. Here 'them' refers to______. i. the cow and the mice ii. the cow and the cat iii. the mice and cat iv. the young man and his wife (p) "Ah how happy I am here!"_______what type of sentence is it? i. Exclamatory sentence ii. Interrogative sentence ill. Imperative sentence iv. Assertive sentence (q) What is the main purpose of the author of this passage? i. To focus on the significance of society. ii. To state the fascination of the young man for rural life. iii. To describe the loneliness of the young man. iv. To highlight the young man's dissatisfaction with jungle life. (r) What is the closest meaning for 'cooperation' in line 11? i. condition ii. converse iii. alteration iv. assistance (s) Which of the following statements is true? i. Happiness lies in the woods. ii. One cannot live without social cooperation. iii. Solitude makes one happy. iv. Family consists of society. (t) The man thought to be______ in the jungle alone. i. sad ii. needy iii. happy iv. unhappy (u) Which of the following statements is true? i. The young man was depressed about his family life in the village. ii. The young man noticed his village life facilitative. iii. The young man preferred jungle life to rural life. iv. The young man had a tendency to move from one place to another. (v) The word 'enmity' in the 2nd line refers to i. amazement ii. amity iii. aversion iv. amenity (w) The man society to live in a jungle. i. needed ii. departed iii. abandoned iv. embraced (x) The young man ended up living in a family ii. living in a prison iii. living in his village iv. living in a city (y) What is the lesson of the text? i. Man should live in jungle. ii. Man should give up family life. Man needs help from others. iv. Man should run away from his duty. (z) What is prerequisite to be a good and happy citizen? i. Li g in a jungle ii. Living in a society iii. Having vast property iv. Having much money 2. Answer the following questions in your own words: 2 x 5 = 10 (a) What was the first disturbance in the hut? (b) Why should we live in a society? (c) What were the parts of everyday life in the village the young man lived? (d) What is the benefit of living in a family or community? (e) Why did the young man leave his house Additional Questions (f) Where did he make a hut? What did he make the but with? (g) Was the man happy in his hut? (h) How did he find himself again in a family? (i) Where and how can a person be happy? (j) What is the moral of the story? (k) Describe the reasons why the cow and the cowboy were brought in the jungle. (l) From your reading of the passage describe the problems the young man encountered in the jungle. (m) What do you think the young man learned after leaving the society to stay in the jungle? (n) "Ah, how happy I am here!" Who says this? Why does he/ she say this? guide_solution: Seen Comprehension-09 Read the passage carefully and answer the questions following it. Unit-3: Lesson-5(B) 26 March, our Independence Day, is the biggest state festival. The day is celebrated every year in the country with great enthusiasm and fervour. It is a national holiday. All offices, educational institutions, shops and factories remain closed on this day. The day begins with 31 gunshots. Early in the morning the President and the Prime Minister on behalf of the nation place floral wreaths at the National Mausoleum at Savar at Savar. Then diplomats, political parties, social and cultural organisations, and freedom fighters pay homage to the martyrs. People from all walks of life also come there with rallies and processions. There are several cultural programmes throughout the day highlighting the heroic struggle and sacrifice in 1971. The country also witness a smartly dressed parade of defence forces, border guards, police, ansars and the VDP (Village Defense Party) at the National Parade Ground near the National Parliament. In Bangabandhu Stadium, school children, scouts and girl guides take part in various displays to entertain thousands of spectators. The educational institutions also organise their individual programmes. Sports meets and tournaments are also organised on the day including the exciting boat race in the river Buriganga. In the evening, all major public buildings are illuminated with colourful lights. Bangla Academy, Bangladesh Shilpakala Academy and other socio-cultural organisations hold cultural functions. Similar functions are also arranged in other places in the country. 1. Choose the correct answer from the following alternatives. 1x7=7 (a) The celebration of the independence Day is considered as____. Unit- 8: Lesson-1 (B) ‘Heritage’ is what we inherit from the past, live with them in the present and then pass on to our children or future generation. Our unique source of life and inspiration is our cultural and natural heritage. When we speak of ‘World Heritage’, it indicates places and sites that we got from the past and pass on to the future generation of the entire world. The ‘Shat Gambuj Mosque’ in Bagerhat is such a heritage. It became a world heritage site in 1985. Originally, the historic Mosque City was known as ‘Khalifatabad’. It is situated at the outskirts of Bagerhat town--- not very far from the dense mangrove forest of the Sundarbans. Khalifatabad was a Muslim colony. It was founded by the Turkish general, a saint warrior Ulugh Khan Jahan in the 15th century. The infrastructure of the city reveals significant technical skills in many mosques as well as early Islamic monuments. Baked bricks are used for the construction of the buildings. The planning of the city is distinctly dominated by Islamic architecture and the decorations are a combination of Mughal and Turkish architecture. Khan Jahan built a network of roads, bridges, public buildings and reservoirs to make the city habitable. There are about 360 mosques in the city. Among them the most remarkable is the multi-domed Shat Gombuj Mosque. The mosque is unique in the sense that it has 60 pillars that support the roof, with 77 low height domes. The 4 towers at 4 corners have smaller domes on the roof as well. The vast prayer hall has 11 arched doorways on the east and 7 each on the north and south for light and ventilation. It has 7 aisles running along the length of the mosque and 11 deep curves between the slender stone columns. These columns support the curving arches created by the domes. The thickness of the arches is 6 feet and have slightly narrowing hollow and round wall. The west wall in the interior has 11 ‘mihrabs’ (niche in mosque pointing towards Makkah). These mihrabs are decorated with stonework and terracotta. The floor of the mosque is made of brick. Besides being used as a prayer hall, Khan Jahan used the mosque as his court also. Today, it is one of the greatest tourist attractions and one of the best architectural beauties of Bangladesh. 1. Unit-11:Lesson-3(B) Countries of the world rely heavily on petroleum, coal and natural gas for their energy sources. There are two major types of energy sources: renewable and non-renewable. Hydro-carbon or fossil fuels are non-renewable sources of energy. Reliance on them poses real big problems. First, fossil fuels such as oil, coal, gas etc, are finite energy resources and the world eventually will run out of them. Secondly, they will become too expensive in the coming decades and too damaging for the environment to repair. Thirdly, fossil fuels have direct polluting impacts on earth’s environment causing global warming. In contrast, renewable energy sources such as, wind and solar energy are constantly and naturally replenished and never run out. Most renewable energy comes either directly or indirectly from the sun. Sunlight or solar energy can be used for heating and lighting homes, for generating electricity and for other commercial and industrial uses. The sun’s heat drives the wind and this wind energy can be captured with wind turbines to produce electricity. Then the wind and the sun’s heat cause water to evaporate. When this water vapour turns into rain or snow and flows downhill into rivers or streams, its energy can be captured as hydroelectric energy. Along with the rain and snow, sunlight causes plants to grow. Plants produce biomass which again can be turned into fuels such as fire wood, alcohol, etc identified as bioenergy. Scientists have identified Hydrogen as another form of renewable energy source. It is the most abundant element in nature. But it does not exist separately as a gas. It is always combined with other elements, such as with oxygen to make water. Hydrogen, separated from another element, can be burned as a fuel to produce electricity. Our Earth’s interior contains molten lava with tremendous heat. This heat inside the Earth produces steam and hot water which can be tapped as geothermal energy to produce electricity, for heating home, etc. Ocean energy comes from several sources. Ocean’s force of tide and wave can be used to produce energy. The surface of the ocean gets more heat from the sun than the ocean depths. This temperature difference can be used as energy source too.
